anenaiva krameṇa sarveṣv araṇyavāsiṣv ādhipatyaṃ tasya babhūva
tathā puruṣakāreṇa vinā daivaṃ na sidhyati

tena kutratyo 'yam iti pṛṣṭā samabhāṣata rājan atītāyāṃ rātrau kācana divyavanitā matpurataḥ kumāramenaṃ saṃsthāpya nidrāmudritāṃ māṃ vibodhya vinītābravīd devi tvanmantriṇo dharmapālanandanasya kāmapālasya vallabhā yakṣakanyāhaṃ tārāvalī nāma nandinī maṇibhadrasya
cirakālamabhūma kāṇabhūte vilasadvismayamodamānacittāḥ
varam alpabalaṃ sāraṃ na kuryān muṇḍamaṇḍalīm
tvaṃ kartā sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ pātā tvaṃ vināśakṛt
rājahaṃsastu praśastavītadainyasainyasametas tīvragatyā nirgatyādhikaruṣaṃ dviṣaṃ rurodha

roṣarūkṣeṇa niṭilākṣeṇa bhasmīkṛtacetane makaraketane tadā bhayenānavadyā vaniteti matvā tasya rolambāvalī keśajālam premākaro rajanīkaro vijitāravindavadanam jayadhvajāyamāno mīno jāyāyuto 'kṣiyugalam sakalasainikāṅgavīro malayasamīro niḥśvāsaḥ pathikahṛddalanakaravālaḥ pravālaścādhārabimbam jayaśaṅkho bandhurā lāvaṇyadharā kandharā pūrṇakumbhau cakravākānukārau payodharau jyāyamāne mārdavāsamāne bisalate ca bāhū īṣadutphullalīlāvataṃsakahlārakorakau gaṅgāvartasanābhir nābhiḥ dūrīkṛtayogimanoratho jaitraratho 'tighanaṃ jaghanam jayastambhabhūte saundaryabhūte vighnitayatijanārambhe rambhe coruyugam ātapatrasahasrapatraṃ pādadvayam astrabhūtāni prasūnāni tānītarāṇyaṅgāni ca samabhūvanniva
sundopasundāv anyonyaṃ naṣṭau tulyabalau na kim
nṛpaḥ tu tasya eva vivṛddhi hetoḥ tad bhāvinā arthena ca codyamānaḥ śame abhireme virarāma pāpāt bheje damam saṃvibabhāja sādhūn
adhyāsyodapatadvyoma gṛhītvā yaṣṭibhājane
tato biḍālas taṃ mūṣikaṃ khāditum upadhāvati
yena svahastastham api suvarṇakaṅkaṇaṃ yasmai kasmaicid dātum icchāmi tathāpi vyāghro mānuṣaṃ khādatīti lokāpavādo durnivāraḥ
tad aham apy evaṃ kiṃ na karomi tataḥ prabhṛti sa nāpitaḥ pratyahaṃ tathāvidho laguḍahastaḥ sunibhṛtaṃ bhikṣor āgamanaṃ pratīkṣate

madvacanasyāmoghatayā bhāvini janane śarīrāntaraṃ gatāyāḥ asyāḥ sarasijākṣyā rasena ramaṇo bhūtvā muhūrtadvayaṃ maccaraṇayugalabandhakāritayā māsadvayaṃ śṛṅkhalānigaḍitacaraṇo ramaṇīviyogaviṣādamanubhūya paścādanekakālaṃ vallabhayā saha rājyasukhaṃ labhasveti
tatastasyaiva mahīruhasya chāyāyāmupaviśya rājā sādarahāsamabhāṣata vayasya bhūsurakāryaṃ kariṣṇurahaṃ mitragaṇo viditārthaḥ sarvathāntarāyaṃ kariṣyatīti nidritānbhavataḥ parityajya niragām
yaḥ puṇyastrīratiparimalodgāribhir nāgarāṇām uddāmāni prathayati śilāveśmabhir yauvanāni
kiṃtvanayor mahānanyognyanisargopajātasneha kathaṃ bhedayituṃ śakyaḥ
kathayāmi yathāpūrvaṃ dakṣādyair munisattamaiḥ
pṛthak śayyā ca nārīṇām aśastravihito vadhaḥ
sa vidheyapadeṣu dakṣatāṃ niyatiṃ loka ivānurudhyate
balavān nihatāmitro mitravān vijitendriyaḥ

janapatirekasmin puṇyadivase tīrthasnānāya pakkaṇanikaṭamārgeṇa gacchannabalayā kayācidupalālitamanupamaśarīraṃ kumāraṃ kaṃcid avalokya kutūhalākulastām apṛcchad bhāmini ruciramūrtiḥ sarājaguṇasaṃpūrtir asāvarbhako bhavadanvayasaṃbhavo na bhavati kasya nayanānandaḥ nimittena kena bhavadadhīno jātaḥ kathyatāṃ yāthātathyena tvayeti

yā vasantasahāyena samutsukatayā rate kelīśālabhañjikāvidhitsayā kaṃcana nārīviśeṣaṃ viracyātmanaḥ krīḍākāsāraśāradāravindasaundaryeṇa pādadvayam udyānavanadīrghikāmattamarālikāgamanarītyā līlālasagativilāsaṃ tūṇīralāvaṇyena jaṅghe līlāmandiradvārakadalīlālityena manojñamūruyugaṃ jaitrarathacāturyeṇa ghanaṃ jaghanam kiṃcidvikasallīlāvataṃsakahlārakorakakoṭarānuvṛttyā gaṅgāvartasanābhiṃ nābhiṃ saudhārohaṇaparipāṭyā valitrayaṃ maurvīmadhukarapaṅktinīlimalīlayā romāvalim pūrṇasuvarṇakalaśaśobhayā kucadvandvaṃ latāmaṇḍapasaukumāryeṇa bāhū jayaśaṅkhābhikhyayā kaṇṭhaṃ kamanīyakarṇapūrasahakārapallavarāgeṇa pratibimbīkṛtabimbaṃ radanacchadanaṃ bāṇāyamānapuṣpalāvaṇyena śuci smitam agradūtikākalakaṇṭhikākalālāpamādhuryeṇa vacanajātaṃ sakalasainikanāyakamalayamārutasaurabhyeṇa niḥśvāsapavanam jayadhvajamīnadarpeṇa locanayugalaṃ cāpayaṣṭiśriyā bhrūlate prathamasuhṛdasudhākarasyāpanītakalaṅkayā kāntyā vadanaṃ līlāmayūrabarhabhaṅgyā keśapāśaṃ ca vidhāya samastamakarandakastūrikāsaṃmitena malayajarasena prakṣālya karpūraparāgeṇa saṃmṛjya nirmiteva rarāja
tathāgatotpādaguṇena tuṣṭāḥ śuddhādhivāsāśca viśuddhasattvāḥ
yataḥ etasya utkṛtyamānasya māṃsāsṛgliptāni asthīni mayā avaśyaṃ prāptavyāni
kaścid siṣeve rataye na kāmam
yadā tu nipatiṣyanti vaśam eṣyanti me tadā
kṛtvā tu tan mahāprājñaḥ sabhaviṣyaṃ sahottaram
svasamīpāt paribhūtās tad yathāyaṃ naśyati tathā vidheyam
asmābhir nirmitā nīḍāś cañcumātrāhṛtais tṛṇaiḥ
śobhayeta guṇairebhirapi tānuttarān kurūn
anujagur atha divyaṃ dundubhidhvānam āśāḥ surakusumanipātair vyomni lakṣmīr vitene
khāt prasrute candramarīciśubhre dve vāridhāre śiśiroṣṇavīrye
kiṃ bhāvi tatra parasthāne kiṃ khāditavān kathaṃ vā prasuptaḥ ity asmaddhṛdayaṃ vidīryate

tatra purato bhayaṅkarajvālākulahutabhugavagāhanasāhasikāṃ mukulitāñjalipuṭāṃ vanitāṃ kāṃcid avalokya sasaṃbhramam analād apanīya kūjantyā vṛddhayā saha matpitur abhyarṇam abhigamayya sthavirāmavocam vṛddhe bhavatyau kutratye
dhūtodyānaṃ kuvalayarajogandhibhir gandhavatyās toyakrīḍāniratayuvatisnānatiktair marudbhiḥ
āgacchatu
manmanorathaphalāyamānaṃ bhavadāgamanamavagamya madrājyāvalambabhūtāmātyānumatyā madanakṛtasārathyena manasā bhavantamāgaccham
pūrvoktāṇḍakapāle dve rodasī kīrtite yataḥ
sā sasaṃbhramam āgatyāmandahṛdayānandasaṃphullavadanāravindā tam upoṣitābhyām ivānimiṣitābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ pibantī vikasvareṇa svareṇa purohitāmātyajanam uccairāhūya tebhyastamadarśayat
acireṇaiva ye tuṣṭāḥ pūrayanti manorathān
vikramārjitarājyasya svayam eva mṛgendratā
taddarśanācca vitrasto vismitaśca babhūva saḥ
pāduke paridhāyaite khecaratvamavāpyate
ādhirvā yadi tatrāsya kāraṇaṃ nopalabhyate
bhaṅgībhaktyā viracitavapuḥ stambhitāntarjalaughaḥ sopānatvaṃ kuru maṇitaṭārohaṇāyāgrayāyī
rājā niṭilataṭacumbitanijacaraṇāmbujaiḥ praśaṃsitadaivamāhātmyair amātyair abhāṇi deva rathyacayaḥ sārathyapagame rathaṃ rabhasādaraṇyamanayad iti
iti vijñāya matimān svasthānaṃ na parityajet
tasminpatite tadavaśiṣṭasainikeṣu palāyiteṣu nānāvidhahayagajādivastujātamādāya paramānandasaṃbhṛto mantrī mamānekavidhāṃ saṃbhāvanāmakārṣīt
nivartyatāṃ sūta bahiḥprayāṇānnarendrasadmaiva rathaḥ prayātu

tato bālacandrikā tayorantaraṅgavṛttiṃ bhāvavivekairjñātvā kāntāsamājasannidhau rājanandanodantasya samyagākhyānamanucitamiti lokasādhāraṇairvākyairabhāṣata bhartṛdārike ayaṃ sakalakalāpravīṇo devatāsānnidhyakaraṇa āhavanipuṇo bhūsurakumāro maṇimantrauṣadhijñaḥ paricaryārhe bhavatyā pūjyatām iti
matibhedatamastirohite gahane kṛtyavidhau vivekinām
vyāḍīndradattau tāṃ rātrimabudhyetāṃ kṣaṇopamām
ādityacandrāvanilānalaś ca dyaur bhūmir āpo hṛdayaṃ yamaś ca
prahlādam ādhāsyati dharmavṛṣṭyā vṛṣṭyā mahāmegha ivātapānte
rājāpi munivākyam aṅgīkṛtyātiṣṭhat
anekagomānuṣāṇāṃ vadhānme putrā mṛtā dārāś ca
mūlaṃ bhujaṅgaiḥ kusumāni bhṛṅgaiḥ śākhāḥ plavaṅgaiḥ śikharāṇi bhallaiḥ
sā bhakṣyaṃ yācamānāṃstānavādītpratipālyatām
mahāmantrī hyayaṃ svecchamacirāttvāṃ vināśayet
dharmaṃ yo na karoti niścalamatiḥ svargārgalodghāṭanaṃ paścāttāpahato jarāpariṇataḥ śokāgninā dahyate
nākāle mriyate jantur viddhaḥ śaraśatair api
tataḥ kānanabhūmiṣu bhavantamanveṣṭumudyuktaṃ māṃ paramamitraṃ bandhupālo niśamyāvadat sakalaṃ dharaṇitalamapāramanveṣṭumakṣamo bhavānmanoglāniṃ vihāya tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhatu
taṃ svasthaṃ codayantīva vañcito 'sītyavekṣitaiḥ
duḥkhārṇavādvyādhivikīrṇaphenājjarātaraṅgānmaraṇogravegāt
rājā ca sāṣṭāṅgapātaṃ praṇamyovāca devi kiṃ me rājyena jīvitena vā mama kiṃ prayojanam yady aham anukampanīyas tadā mamāyuḥśeṣeṇāpy ayaṃ sadāraputro vīravaro jīvatu
tato 'nutāpena mayā mahāvratamagṛhyata
yasya kasya prasūto 'pi guṇavān pūjyate naraḥ
virodhidaivadhikkṛtapuruṣakāro dainyavyāptākāro magadhādhipatir adhikādhiramātyasaṃmatyā mṛdubhāṣitayā tayā vasumatyā matyā kalitayā ca samabodhi
kautūhalāt sphītataraiśca netrairnīlotpalārdhairiva kīryamāṇam
asnātaṃ na spṛśāmi tvāṃ tatsnāhi praviśāntaram
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ śirasā vāpi kartanam
tacchrutvā sā gatā sakhyā mātuḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat
avibhidya niśākṛtaṃ tamaḥ prabhayā nāṃśumatāpy udīyate
gatvā cordhvaṃ daśamukhabhujocchvāsitaprasthasaṃdheḥ kailāsasya tridaśavanitādarpaṇasyātithiḥ syāḥ
vacanaśatam avacanakare buddhiśatam acetane naṣṭam
doṣabhīter anārambhas tat kāpuruṣalakṣaṇam
imau munī pārthivalakṣmaṇānvitau kuśīlavau caiva mahātapasvinau
darbhamunmūlayāmyatra pādo hyetena me kṣataḥ
mātaṅgo 'pi rājavāhanānumatyā tāṃ taruṇīṃ pariṇīya divyāṅganālābhena hṛṣṭataro rasātalarājyamurarīkṛtya paramānandamāsasāda
prātarbrāhmaṇapūjārthaṃ vyasarji vaṇijastayā
rūpasya hantrī vyasanaṃ balasya śokasya yonirnidhanaṃ ratīnām

tatra tathāvidhāvasthāmanubhavantīṃ manmathānalasaṃtaptāṃ sukumārīṃ kumārīṃ nirīkṣya khinno vayasyagaṇaḥ kāñcanakalaśasaṃcitāni haricandanośīraghanasāramilitāni tadabhiṣekakalpitāni salilāni bisatantumayāni vāsāṃsi ca nalinīdalamayāni tālavṛntāni ca santāpaharaṇāni bahūni sampādya tasyāḥ śarīram aśiśirayat
yadi tvam uttaraṃ dāsyasi tadā tvanmaraṇam
durnītaṃ kim ihāsti kiṃ sucaritaṃ kaḥ sthānalābhe guṇaḥ kālo hi vyasanaprasāritakaro gṛhṇāti dūrād api
tanmātrāṇy aviśeṣāṇi aviśeṣās tato hi te
prītaśca tebhyo dvijasattamebhyaḥ satkārapūrvaṃ pradadau dhanāni
hārāṃs tārāṃs taralaguṭikān koṭiśaḥ śaṅkhaśuktīḥ śaṣpaśyāmān marakatamaṇīn unmayūkhaprarohān
tasminnavasare mālavendramahiṣī parijanaparivṛtā duhitṛkelīvilokanāya taṃ deśamavāpa
jano nityaṃ bhūyāt sakalasukhasampattivasatiḥ kathārambhe rambhye satatam iha bālo 'pi ramatām
kiṃca daivajñakathito mathitoddhatārātiḥ sārvabhaumo 'bhirāmo bhavitā sukumāraḥ kumārastvadudare vasati

sa vayasyagaṇādapanīya rahasi punarenam abhāṣata rājan atīte niśānte gaurīpatiḥ svapnasaṃnihito nidrāmudritalocanaṃ vibodhya prasannavadanakāntiḥ praśrayānataṃ māmavocan mātaṅga daṇḍakāraṇyāntarālagāminyās taṭinyās tīrabhūmau siddhasādhyārādhyamānasya sphaṭikaliṅgasya paścād adripatikanyāpadapaṅkticihnitasyāśmanaḥ savidhe vidherānanamiva kimapi bilaṃ vidyate

no cedabjabhūrevaṃvidho nirmāṇanipuṇo yadi syāttarhi tatsamānalāvaṇyāmanyāṃ taruṇīṃ kiṃ na karoti iti savismayānurāgaṃ vilokayatastasya samakṣaṃ sthātuṃ lajjitā satī kiṃcit sakhījanāntaritagātrā tannayanābhimukhaiḥ kiṃcid ākuñcitabhrūlatair apāṅgavīkṣitair ātmanaḥ kuraṅgasyānāyamānalāvaṇyaṃ rājavāhanaṃ vilokayantyatiṣṭhat
duṣpraṇītaḥ kāma krodhābhyām avajñānāt _ vānaprastha parivrājakān api kopayati kim aṅga punar gṛhasthān
tadālocya niścitatatkṛtyairamātyai rājā vijñāpito 'bhūd deva nirupāyena devasahāyena yoddhumarātirāyāti
kathaṃ tvam etau dhṛtisaṃyamau yamau vilokayann utsahase na bādhitum
atha gacchato gopālasya mastakāvasthitadadhibhāṇḍād vāraṃ vāraṃ tena kākena dadhi khādyate

tenābhāṣi bhūbhramaṇabalinā prāñjalinā deva śirasi devasyājñāmādāyainaṃ nirdoṣaṃ veṣaṃ svīkṛtya mālavendranagaraṃ praviśya tatra gūḍhataraṃ vartamānastasya rājñaḥ samastamudantajātaṃ viditvā pratyāgamam
kaḥ saṃnaddhe virahavidhurāṃ tvayyupekṣeta jāyāṃ na syādanyo 'pyahamiva jano yaḥ parādhīnavṛttiḥ
tadā durgāśrayaṇam eva niṣprayojanam
śivās te santu panthānaḥ
yatronmattabhramaramukharāḥ pādapā nityapuṣpā haṃsaśreṇīracitaraśanā nityapadmā nalinyaḥ
kulācārajanācārair atiśuddhaḥ pratāpavān
kulāt tatas asmai sthira śīla yuktāt sādhum vapus hrī vinaya upapannām yaśodharām nāma yaśas viśālām vāma abhidhānām śriyam ājuhāva
puṣpodbhavaśca nijakāryakaraṇaṃ tarkayannenamādareṇa babhāṣe nanu satāṃ sakhyasyābhāṣaṇapūrvatayā ciraṃ rucirabhāṣaṇo bhavānasmākaṃ priyavayasyo jātaḥ
na cāpriyaṃ prāṇiṣu yo bravīti sa sāgarāntāṃ pṛthivīṃ praśāsti

mama purobhāge dinamadhyasaṃkucitasarvāvayavāṃ kūrmākṛtiṃ mānuṣacchāyāṃ nirīkṣyonmukho gaganatalānmahārayeṇa patantaṃ puruṣaṃ kaṃcid antarāla eva dayopanatahṛdayo 'ham avalambya śanairavanitale nikṣipya dūrāpātavītasaṃjñaṃ taṃ śiśiropacāreṇa vibodhya śokātirekeṇodgatabāṣpalocanaṃ taṃ bhṛgupatanakāraṇamapṛccham
nānivedya prakurvīta bhartuḥ kiṃcid api svayam
mahattvayogāya mahāmahimnām ārādhanīṃ tāṃ nṛpa devatānām
tau ca ciravirahaduḥkhaṃ visṛjyānyonyāliṅganasukhamanvabhūtām
prāpya cāntaḥpurebhyas tān strīrūpān puruṣāṃs tataḥ
pitā tvāṃ ca niyuṅkte sma śuśrūṣāyai mamātitheḥ
kṣamā śatrau ca mitre ca yatīnām eva bhūṣaṇam
tapasvivyañjanopetaiḥ svacaraiḥ saha saṃvaset
gṛdhrāśca bahavastuṇḍairahipatīnādāya divi samacaran
śakuniḥ śakaṭāraś ca dṛṣṭāntāv atra bhūpate
sarvahiṃsānivṛttā ye narāḥ sarvasahāś ca ye
abhūtāṃ bhrātarau viprāvatiprītau parasparam
nadīnāṃ śastrapāṇīnāṃ nakhināṃ śṛṅgiṇāṃ tathā
sa ca tāṃ tadā tvadaṅkāpāśrayāṃ suratakhedasuptagātrīṃ tribhuvanasargayātrāsaṃhārasambaddhābhiḥ kathābhir amṛtasyandinībhiḥ pratyānīyamānarāgapūrāṃ nyarūpayat
āgatyāgre tato rājñe cārābhyāṃ sa niveditaḥ
hasitaṃ kimu teneti pṛṣṭā bhūyaḥ sutaiśca sā
tathā iti rājavāhanaḥ sākaṃ mātaṅgena namitottamāṅgena vihāyārdharātre nidrāparatantraṃ mitragaṇaṃ vanāntaramavāpa

tato devasyānveṣaṇaparāyaṇo 'hamakhilakāryanimittaṃ vittaṃ niścitya bhavadanugrahāllabdhasya sādhakasya sāhāyyakaraṇadakṣaṃ śiṣyagaṇaṃ niṣpādya vindhyavanamadhye purātanapattanasthānānyupetya vividhasūcakānāṃ mahīruhāṇāmadhonikṣiptān vasupūrṇān kalaśān siddhāñjanena jñātvā rakṣiṣu paritaḥ sthiteṣu khananasādhanairutpāṭya dīnārānasaṃkhyān rāśīkṛtya tatkālāgatamanatidūre niveśitaṃ vaṇikkaṭakaṃ kaṃcid abhyetya tatra balino balīvardān goṇīśca krītvānyadravyamiṣeṇa vasu tadgoṇīsaṃcitaṃ tairuhyamānaṃ śanaiḥ kaṭakamanayam
tato 'tirayaturaṅgamaṃ madrathaṃ tannikaṭaṃ nītvā śīghralaṅghanopetatadīyaratho 'hamarāteḥ śiraḥkartanamakārṣam
mālavendro 'pi tadadbhutaṃ manyamānastasmai vāḍavāya pracurataraṃ dhanaṃ dattvā vidyeśvaram idānīṃ sādhaya iti visṛjya svayamantarmandiraṃ jagāma
anupagatajarāḥ payasvinīr gāḥ svayamadadātsutavṛddhaye dvijebhyaḥ
utathyasya ca bhāryāyāṃ mamatāyāṃ mahātapaḥ
tasmāt saṃbhakṣayatvekaḥ pratyahaṃ sajalānamūn
sitacchadānām apadiśya dhāvatāṃ rutair amīṣāṃ grathitāḥ patatriṇām
tathāpi yathāśakti bandhanam eteṣāṃ khaṇḍaya

sarveṣāṃ suhṛdām ekadaivānukūladaivābhāvena mahadāścaryaṃ bibhrāṇo rājā ratnodbhavaḥ katham abhavad iti cintayaṃstannandanaṃ puṣpodbhavanāmadheyaṃ vidhāya tadudantaṃ vyākhyāya suśrutāya viṣādasaṃtoṣāvanubhavaṃstadanujatanayaṃ samarpitavān
asti campakābhidhānāyāṃ nagaryāṃ parivrājakāv asathaḥ
kathaṃ nāma na sevyante yatnataḥ parameśvarāḥ
taṃ ca vāsagṛhe citrapaṭaṃ bhittāvakārayat
velāṃ samudre sagaraśca dadhre nekṣvākavo yāṃ prathamaṃ babandhuḥ
etacchrutvā pakṣibhir uktamanayor deśayoḥ ko deśo bhadrataro rājā ca
tanniśamya satyavarmasthiteḥ samyaganiścitatayā khinnamānaso narapatiḥ sumataye mantriṇe somadattaṃ nāma tadanujatanayamarpitavān
kapāleṣu śmaśāneṣu kasmāddeva ratistava
tenārthitvaṃ tvayi vidhivaśāddūrabandhurgato 'haṃ yācñā moghā varam adhiguṇe nādhame labdhakāmā
paścāt tena jāreṇa samaṃ tasmin paryaṅke nirbharaṃ krīḍantī paryaṅkatalasthitasya bhartuḥ kiṃcid aṅgasparśāt svāminaṃ māyāvinaṃ vijñāya manasi sā viṣaṇṇābhavat
dvāḥsthakathitāsmadāgamanena sādaraṃ vihitābhyudgatinā tena dvāropāntanivāritāśeṣaparivāreṇa madanvitā bālacandrikā saṅketāgāram anīyata
sa ca vidyeśvaranāmadheyo 'hamaindrajālikavidyākovido vividhadeśeṣu rājamanorañjanāya bhramannujjayinīmadyāgato 'smi iti śaśaṃsa
paśya bhartaścitaṃ cūtaṃ kusumairmadhugandhibhiḥ
kiṃ na bhartā mamāhūtastvayā tātocyatāmiti
kariṣyase yatra suduścarāṇi prasattaye gotrabhidas tapāṃsi
ṭiṭṭibho 'vadad bhārye nanv idam eva sthānaṃ prasūtiyogyam
aparedyuś citravarṇo rājā gṛdhram uvāca tāta svapratijñātam adhunā nirvāhaya
manthareṇoktaṃ bhadra mṛga kuśalaṃ te svecchayā udakādyāhāro 'nubhūyatām
vidyādharāṇāṃ saptānāmapūrvaṃ caritādbhutam
tadākarṇya militā janāḥ samudyadbāṣpā hāhāninādena diśo badhirayantaḥ bālacandrikāmadhiṣṭhitaṃ yakṣaṃ balavantaṃ śṛṇvannapi dāruvarmā madāndhastāmevāyācata
itare mantrisūnavaḥ purandarapurātithiṣu pitṛṣu yathāpūrvamanvatiṣṭhan
niḥsṛtya kubjāśca mahākulebhyo vyūhāśca kairātakavāmanānām
daridrāṇāṃ kulīnānāṃ bhāṇḍamūlyaṃ dadāti saḥ
pāduke paridhāyaite khecaratvamavāpyate
karaṭako brūte sarvasminn adhikāre ya eva niyuktaḥ pradhānamantrī sa karotu
sa tu svabhāvadhīraḥ sarvapauruṣātibhūmiḥ sahiṣṇutaikapratikriyāṃ daivīmeva tāmāpadamavadhārya smara tasyā haṃsagāmini haṃsakathāyāḥ
sucintitaṃ cauṣadham āturāṇāṃ na nāmamātreṇa karoty arogam

roṣarūkṣeṇa niṭilākṣeṇa bhasmīkṛtacetane makaraketane tadā bhayenānavadyā vaniteti matvā tasya rolambāvalī keśajālam premākaro rajanīkaro vijitāravindavadanam jayadhvajāyamāno mīno jāyāyuto 'kṣiyugalam sakalasainikāṅgavīro malayasamīro niḥśvāsaḥ pathikahṛddalanakaravālaḥ pravālaścādhārabimbam jayaśaṅkho bandhurā lāvaṇyadharā kandharā pūrṇakumbhau cakravākānukārau payodharau jyāyamāne mārdavāsamāne bisalate ca bāhū īṣadutphullalīlāvataṃsakahlārakorakau gaṅgāvartasanābhir nābhiḥ dūrīkṛtayogimanoratho jaitraratho 'tighanaṃ jaghanam jayastambhabhūte saundaryabhūte vighnitayatijanārambhe rambhe coruyugam ātapatrasahasrapatraṃ pādadvayam astrabhūtāni prasūnāni tānītarāṇyaṅgāni ca samabhūvanniva
śarīreṇa samaṃ nāśaṃ sarvam anyaddhi gacchati
suhṛdāmakathyaṃ ca kimasti kelivane 'sminvasantamahotsavāyāgatāyā mālavendrasutāyā rājanandanasyāsya cākasmikadarśane 'nyonyānuragātirekaḥ samajāyata
tathā niṣaṇṇaṃ ca tam upahāravarmārthapālapramatimitraguptamantraguptaviśrutair maithilena ca prahāravarmaṇā kāśībhartrā ca kāmapālena campeśvareṇa siṃhavarmaṇā sahopāgatya dhanamitraḥ praṇipapāta
vikale'pi hi parjanye jīvyate na tu bhūpatau
śāpānto me bhujagaśayanād utthite śārṅgapāṇau śeṣān māsān gamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
mahodayais tasya hitānubandhibhiḥ pratīyate dhātur ivehitaṃ phalaiḥ
tasmād gaccher anu kanakhalaṃ śailarājāvatīrṇāṃ jahnoḥ kanyāṃ sagaratanayasvargasopānapaṅktim
tām uttīrya vraja paricitabhrūlatāvibhramāṇāṃ pakṣmotkṣepād uparivilasatkṛṣṇaśāraprabhāṇām
divyābdānāṃ sahasrāṇi yugeṣv āhuḥ purāvidaḥ
niṣkampakṛṣṇāyataśuddhapakṣme draṣṭuṃ samarthe khalu sarvabhāvān
tenaiva vipaṇiṃ kṛtvā dhanena nijakauśalāt
viharansuciraṃ tatra mahendra iva nandane
svalpasnāyuvasāvaśeṣamalinaṃ nirmāṃsam apy asthikaṃ śvā labdhvā paritoṣam eti na bhavet tasya kṣudhaḥ śāntaye
tasmin tathā bhūmipatau pravṛtte bhṛtyāḥ ca paurāḥ ca tathā eva ceruḥ śama ātmake cetasi viprasanne prayukta yogasya yathā indriyāṇi
pañcabhirmilitaiḥ kiṃ yajjagatīha na sādhyate
chettāraḥ saṃśayānāṃ ca kliśyante lobhamohitāḥ
jijñāsārthamathābhyāṃ me prātiśākhyam apaṭhyata
tathā hi loke paṇḍitā api dākṣiṇyenākāryaṃ kurvanti iti
kadācidatha samprāptā prāvṛṭ tasyāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ
nāpy anyasmāt praṇayakalahād viprayogopapattir vitteśānāṃ na ca khalu vayo yauvanād anyad asti

sa vayasyagaṇādapanīya rahasi punarenam abhāṣata rājan atīte niśānte gaurīpatiḥ svapnasaṃnihito nidrāmudritalocanaṃ vibodhya prasannavadanakāntiḥ praśrayānataṃ māmavocan mātaṅga daṇḍakāraṇyāntarālagāminyās taṭinyās tīrabhūmau siddhasādhyārādhyamānasya sphaṭikaliṅgasya paścād adripatikanyāpadapaṅkticihnitasyāśmanaḥ savidhe vidherānanamiva kimapi bilaṃ vidyate
tayor vivādo mantavyo nottamādhamayoḥ kvacit

so 'yameva hyamunā rūpaṇe dhanamitrākhyayā cāntarito mantavyaḥ sa evāyaṃ nirgamapyabandhanād aṅgarājamapavarjitaṃ ca kośavāhanamekīkṛtyāsmadgṛhyeṇāmunā saha rājanyakenaikānte sukhopaviṣṭamiha devamupatiṣṭhatu yadi na doṣaḥ iti
pratasthe dehamokṣāya puṇyaṃ badarikāśramam
pāpaśaṅkā na kartavyā śṛṇutaṃ kathayāmi vām
tvamenaṃ manojasaṃnibhamabhivardhaya iti vismayavikasitanayanayā mayā savinayaṃ satkṛtā svakṣī yakṣī sāpy adṛśyatām ayāsīd iti
śokārtenāsya śakuneḥ kim idaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ mayā
kāṇena cakṣuṣā kiṃ vā cakṣuḥ pīḍaiva kevalam
ambeti vācaṃ karuṇaṃ bruvāṇaḥ paraṃ samāśritya naraḥ ka eṣaḥ
sa ca yajñārthaṃ grāmāntarācchāgam upakrīya skandhe nītvā gaccha dhūrtatrayeṇāvalokitaḥ
ṛṣayo 'bhyāgaman sarve vadhāyāsurarakṣasām

samutsukayā rājakanyayā marālagrahaṇe niyuktāṃ bālacandrikāmavalokya samucito vākyāvasara iti sambhāṣaṇanipuṇo rājavāhanaḥ salīlamalapat sakhi purā śāmbo nāma kaścinmahīvallabho manovallabhayā saha vihāravāñchayā kamalākaramavāpya tatra kokanadakadambasamīpe nidrādhīnamānasaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ śanair gṛhītvā bisaguṇena tasya caraṇayugalaṃ nigaḍayitvā kāntāmukhaṃ sānurāgaṃ vilokayan mandasmitavikasitaikakapolamaṇḍalas tām abhāṣata indumukhi mayā baddho marālaḥ śānto munivadāste
adīpitaṃ vaidyutajātavedasā sitāmbudacchedatirohitātapam
asrais tāvan muhur upacitair dṛṣṭir ālupyate me krūras tasminn api na sahate saṃgamaṃ nau kṛtāntaḥ
atha viditavārtāvārtau mahādevīmālavendrau jāmātaram ākārapakṣapātināv ātmaparityāgopanyāsenāriṇā jighāṃsyamānaṃ rarakṣatuḥ
ādhārayan pāṇḍaramātapatraṃ bodhāya jepuḥ paramāśiṣaśca
mānapālo nijakiṅkarebhyo mama kulābhimānavṛttāntaṃ tatkālīnaṃ vikramaṃ ca niśamya māmārcayat
tadenamupāyamaṅgīkṛtya vigatasādhvasalajjā bhavajjanakajananīsahodarāṇāṃ purata āvayoḥ premātiśayamākhyāya sarvathāsmatpariṇayakaraṇe tānanunayeḥ
jāyante bata mūḍhānāṃ saṃvādā api tādṛśāḥ
sa mahyaṃ bhavatīṃ prādāddharmādibhyo 'parāśca tāḥ

roṣarūkṣeṇa niṭilākṣeṇa bhasmīkṛtacetane makaraketane tadā bhayenānavadyā vaniteti matvā tasya rolambāvalī keśajālam premākaro rajanīkaro vijitāravindavadanam jayadhvajāyamāno mīno jāyāyuto 'kṣiyugalam sakalasainikāṅgavīro malayasamīro niḥśvāsaḥ pathikahṛddalanakaravālaḥ pravālaścādhārabimbam jayaśaṅkho bandhurā lāvaṇyadharā kandharā pūrṇakumbhau cakravākānukārau payodharau jyāyamāne mārdavāsamāne bisalate ca bāhū īṣadutphullalīlāvataṃsakahlārakorakau gaṅgāvartasanābhir nābhiḥ dūrīkṛtayogimanoratho jaitraratho 'tighanaṃ jaghanam jayastambhabhūte saundaryabhūte vighnitayatijanārambhe rambhe coruyugam ātapatrasahasrapatraṃ pādadvayam astrabhūtāni prasūnāni tānītarāṇyaṅgāni ca samabhūvanniva
akuruta japahomamaṅgalādyāḥ paramabhavāya sutasya devatejyāḥ
upāgame duścaritā ivāpadāṃ gatiṃ na niścetum alaṃ śilīmukhāḥ
tasyāḥ pātuṃ suragaja iva vyomni paścārdhalambī tvaṃ ced acchasphaṭikaviśadaṃ tarkayes tiryag ambhaḥ
brahmacāriṇaḥ svādhyāyaḥ agni kārya abhiṣekau bhaikṣa vrati tvam ācārye prāṇāntikā vṛttiḥ tad abhāve guru putre sabrahmacāriṇi _
sā cākasmātsagarbhābhūt taddṛṣṭvā vatsagulmayoḥ
ājñābhaṅgo narendrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇānām anādaraḥ
yadi daivāt phalaṃ nāsti chāyā kena nivāryate
śarīra saṃdeha kare api kāle saṃgrāma sammarde iva pravṛtte svasthāḥ sukham ca eva nirāmayam ca prajajñire kāla vaśena nāryaḥ
catasṛṣv api te vivekinī nṛpa vidyāsu nirūḍhim āgatā
vigalitajalabhāraśuklabhāsāṃ nicaya ivāmbumucāṃ nagādhirājaḥ

sarveṣāṃ suhṛdām ekadaivānukūladaivābhāvena mahadāścaryaṃ bibhrāṇo rājā ratnodbhavaḥ katham abhavad iti cintayaṃstannandanaṃ puṣpodbhavanāmadheyaṃ vidhāya tadudantaṃ vyākhyāya suśrutāya viṣādasaṃtoṣāvanubhavaṃstadanujatanayaṃ samarpitavān
putro janiṣyate cātra yuṣmatsvasurasaṃśayam
mayā buddhiprabhāvād asya maraṇaṃ sādhayitavyam
dṛṣṭvā yasyāṃ vipaṇiracitān vidrumāṇāṃ ca bhaṅgān saṃlakṣyante salilanidhayas toyamātrāvaśeṣāḥ
tato gateṣu katipayadineṣu paurajanasamakṣaṃ siddhādeśaprakāreṇa vivāhya tāmindumukhīṃ pūrvasaṃkalpitān surataviśeṣān yatheṣṭamanvabhūvam
niścalaiḥ prītivikacaiḥ pibantya iva locanaiḥ
kaurmaṃ saṅkocam āsthāya prahāram api marṣayet
tadīyārbhakayoryamayordhātrībhāvena parikalpitāhaṃ madduhitāpi tīvragatiṃ bhūpatimanugantumakṣame abhūva
rakṣitaṃ vardhayec caiva vṛddhaṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet
garbhabharālasāṃ tāṃ lalanāṃ dhātrībhāvena kalpitāhaṃ karābhyāmudvahantī phalakamekamadhiruhya daivagatyā tīrabhūmimagamam
śriyaḥ kurūṇām adhipasya pālanīṃ prajāsu vṛttiṃ yam ayuṅkta veditum
nākuṇḍalī nāmukuṭī nāsragvī nālpabhogavān
pṛṣṭhataḥ sevayed arkaṃ jaṭhareṇa hutāśanam

athaikadā vāmadevaḥ sakalakalākuśalena kusumasāyakasaṃśayitasaundaryeṇa kalpitasodaryeṇa sāhasāpahasitakumāreṇa sukumāreṇa jayadhvajātapavāraṇakuliśāṅkitakareṇa kumāranikareṇa pariveṣṭitaṃ rājānamānataśirasaṃ samabhigamya tena tāṃ kṛtāṃ paricaryāmaṅgīkṛtya nijacaraṇakamalayugalamilanmadhukarāyamāṇakākapakṣaṃ vidaliṣyamāṇavipakṣaṃ kumāracayaṃ gāḍhamāliṅgya mitasatyavākyena vihitāśīr abhyabhāṣata
prāṇebhyo 'pi hi dhīrāṇāṃ priyā śatrupratikriyā

nirjane vane kiṃnimittaṃ rudyate tvayā iti pṛṣṭā sā karasaroruhairaśru pramṛjya sagadgadaṃ māmavocan mune lāvaṇyajitapuṣpasāyake mithilānāyake kīrtivyāptasudharmaṇi nijasuhṛdo magadharājasya sīmantinīsīmantamahotsavāya putradārasamanvite puṣpapuramupetya kaṃcana kālam adhivasati samārādhitagirīśo mālavādhīśo magadharājaṃ yoddhumabhyagāt
tadvadeva bhavānbhaviṣyati
tatas tena nakulena bālakasamīpam āgacchan kṛṣṇasarpo dṛṣṭo vyāpādya kopāt khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣitaś ca
tasya tā vapuṣākṣiptā nigṛhītaṃ jajṛmbhire
anyathā anāhāreṇātmānaṃ tava dvāri vyāpādayiṣyāmīti
durgadāho meghavarṇena vāyasena gṛdhrapratyuktena kṛtaḥ
tataḥ kadācidadhyāsta vasantasamayotsave
ākhyāsyati hyeṣa vimokṣamārgaṃ mārgapranaṣṭebhya ivādhvagebhyaḥ
suhṛdāmakathyaṃ ca kimasti kelivane 'sminvasantamahotsavāyāgatāyā mālavendrasutāyā rājanandanasyāsya cākasmikadarśane 'nyonyānuragātirekaḥ samajāyata
sthānād asmāt sarasaniculād utpatodaṅmukhaḥ khaṃ diṅnāgānāṃ pathi pariharan sthūlahastāvalepān
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śṛgālo 'cintayat katham etanmāṃsaṃ sulalitaṃ bhakṣayāmi bhavatu viśvāsaṃ tāvad utpādayāmi ity ālocya upasṛtyābravīnmitra kuśalaṃ te
itare mantrisūnavaḥ purandarapurātithiṣu pitṛṣu yathāpūrvamanvatiṣṭhan
kiṃ bahunā viśrambhālāpair mayaiva sahātra kālo nīyatām

tataḥ kasyāpi punnāgabhūruhasya chāyāśītale tale saṃviṣṭena manujanāthena sapraṇayamabhāṇi sakhe kālametāvantaṃ deśe kasmin prakāreṇa kenāsthāyi bhavatā saṃprati kutra gamyate taruṇī keyaṃ eṣa parijanaḥ sampāditaḥ kathaṃ kathaya iti
prasādavittakaḥ śaṃbhoḥ puṣpadanto gaṇottamaḥ
sāhaṃ mohaṃ gatā kenāpi kṛpālunā vṛṣṇipālena svakuṭīramāveśya viropitavraṇābhavam
asmajjananyośca tataḥ sphuṭitaṃ hṛdayaṃ śucā
sa saṃkocavikāsābhyāṃ pradhānatve 'pi ca sthitaḥ
ahaṃ tava cakṣuṣī cañcvā kim api vilikhāmi yadāhaṃ śabdaṃ karomi tadā tvam utthāya satvaraṃ palāyiṣyase
maharṣikalpo rājarṣis triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
kriyāsu yuktair nṛpa cāracakṣuṣo na vañcanīyāḥ prabhavo 'nujīvibhiḥ
mohena vā kāmasukhairmadādvā yo naiṣṭhikaṃ śroṣyati nāsya dharmam
sadānukūleṣu hi kurvate ratiṃ nṛpeṣv amātyeṣu ca sarvasampadaḥ
sa ca punar me svāmī māṃ vikretuṃ devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo vā dātum īśvaraḥ
etaiḥ sandhiṃ na kurvīta vigṛhṇīyāt tu kevalam
tasmāt tu mithunād ekaṃ pumāṃsaṃ pāpaniścayaḥ
tasminvane śrīmati rājapatnī prasūtikālaṃ samavekṣamāṇā
taṃ ced vāyau sarati saralaskandhasaṃghaṭṭajanmā bādhetolkākṣapitacamarībālabhāro davāgniḥ
iti narapatiputrajanmavṛddhyā sajanapadaṃ kapilāhvayaṃ puraṃ tat
sa kūrma iva durbuddhiḥ kāṣṭhād bhraṣṭo vinaśyati
pañcabhirmilitaiḥ kiṃ yajjagatīha na sādhyate
teṣāṃ sitavarmaṇaḥ sumatisatyavarmāṇau dharmapālasya sumantrasumitrakāmapālāḥ padmodbhavasya suśrutaratnodbhavāviti tanayāḥ samabhūvan
ekakāle hi sṛjyante saṃhriyante ca pūrvavat
mūlabhṛtyān parityajya nāgantūn pratimānayet
kālī sāsūyamekadā dhātryā mayā saha bālamenamekena miṣeṇānīya taṭinyāmetasyāmakṣipat

bhūpatir āyāntaṃ taṃ vilokya samyagjñātatadīyagūḍhacārabhāvo nikhilamanucaranikaraṃ visṛjya mantrijanasametaḥ praṇatamenaṃ mandahāsamabhāṣata nanu tāpasa deśaṃ sāpadeśaṃ bhramanbhavāṃstatra tatra bhavadabhijñātaṃ kathayatu iti
tad enāṃ gāndharvavivāhena pariṇayatu bhavān
patraśyāmā dinakarahayaspardhino yatra vāhāḥ śailodagrās tvam iva kariṇo vṛṣṭimantaḥ prabhedāt
niśitaśaranikaraśakalīkṛtāpi sā paśupatiśāsanasyāvandhyatayā sūtaṃ nihatya rathasthaṃ rājānaṃ mūrchitamakārṣīt
yadrājaśāstraṃ bhṛguraṅgirā vā na cakratur vaṃśakarāvṛṣī tau
etāny api satāṃ gehe nocchidyante kadācana
ekāntasukhino devā manuṣyā nityaduḥkhitāḥ
jāne sakhyās tava mayi manaḥ saṃbhṛtasnehamasmād itthaṃbhūtāṃ prathamavirahe tām ahaṃ tarkayāmi

evaṃ mitravṛttāntaṃ niśamyāmlānamānaso rājavāhanaḥ svasya ca somadattasya ca vṛttāntamasmai nivedya somadattaṃ mahākāleśvarārādhanānantaraṃ bhavadvallabhāṃ saparivārāṃ nijakaṭakaṃ prāpayyāgaccha iti niyujya puṣpodbhavena sevyamāno bhūsvargāyamānamavantikāpuraṃ viveśa
iti pṛṣṭastato devyā bhagavānidamabravīt
sakṛt kiṃ pīḍitaṃ snānavastraṃ muñced dhṛtaṃ payaḥ
bhokṣyase dhuri cānyeṣāmehi tāvadgṛhaṃ mama
paramārthas tvam evaiko nānyo 'sti jagataḥ pate
niśāyāṃ nabhasā tatra pādukābhyāṃ jagāma saḥ
pūrvoktāṇḍakapāle dve rodasī kīrtite yataḥ
nikṛṣṭotkṛṣṭayorbhāvaṃ yā gṛhṇanti tu tāḥ striyaḥ

paredyuḥ prabhāte vidyeśvaro rasabhāvarītigaticaturastādṛśena mahatā nijaparijanena saha rājabhavanadvārāntikamupetya dauvārikaniveditanijavṛttāntaḥ sahasopagamya sapraṇāmam aindrajālikaḥ samāgataḥ iti dvāḥsthair vijñāpitena taddarśanakutūhalāviṣṭena samutsukāvarodhasahitena mālavendreṇa samāhūyamāno vidyeśvaraḥ kakṣāntaraṃ praviśya savinayam āśiṣaṃ dattvā tadanujñātaḥ parijanatāḍyamāneṣu vādyeṣu nadatsu gāyakīṣu madanakalakokilāmañjuladhvaniṣu samadhikarāgarañjitasāmājikamanovṛttiṣu picchikābhramaṇeṣu saparivāraṃ parivṛttaṃ bhrāmayanmukulitanayanaḥ kṣaṇamatiṣṭhat
tasya pracure'pi vitte 'parān bandhūn atisamṛddhān samīkṣya punar arthavṛddhiḥ karaṇīyeti matir babhūva
ahaṃ samīpalatāgulmake praviśya parīkṣamāṇo 'tiṣṭham nipatitaṃ bālakaṃ pallavakavalamivādadati gajapatau kaṇṭhīravo mahāgraheṇa nyapatat
bhūpeṣu rājeta yathā prakāśaḥ graheṣu sarveṣu ravervibhāti
tatra gatvā sakalavṛttāntaṃ ṭiṭṭibhena bhagavato garuḍasya purato niveditaṃ deva samudreṇāhaṃ svagṛhāvasthito vināparādhanenaiva nigṛhītaḥ
tatastau kasyacidāśrame munerasthāpayam
bhāryāṃ kṣīṇeṣu vitteṣu vyasaneṣu ca bāndhavān
āvayor yodhamukhyābhyāṃ madarthaḥ sādhyatām iti
śyāmāsv aṅgaṃ cakitahariṇīprekṣaṇe dṛṣṭipātaṃ vaktracchāyāṃ śaśini śikhināṃ barhabhāreṣu keśān
ahaṃ tava cakṣuṣī cañcvā kim api vilikhāmi yadāhaṃ śabdaṃ karomi tadā tvam utthāya satvaraṃ palāyiṣyase
didṛkṣayā harmyatalāni jagmurjanena mānyena kṛtābhyanujñāḥ
priyāsu nārīṣv adhaneṣu bāndhaveṣv ativyayo nāsti narādhipāṣṭasu
apṛṣṭas tasya na brūyād yaś ca necchet parābhavam
vyaktāvyakte tathaivānye rūpe kālas tathāparam
tasyākṣiṇī nirnimiṣe viśāle snigdhe ca dīpte vimale tathaiva
sadaikarūparūpāya viṣṇave sarvajiṣṇave
bhāṣātrayamidaṃ tyaktaṃ yanmanuṣyeṣu sambhavet
suratakhedasuptayostu tayoḥ svapne bisaguṇanigaḍitapādo jaraṭhaḥ kaścijjālapādo 'dṛśyata
haṃsābhyāṃ nīyamānasya kūrmasya patanaṃ yathā
saṃvego 'traiva kartavyo yadā teṣāmapi kṣayaḥ

sarveṣu tadaindrajālikameva karma iti sādbhutaṃ paśyatsu rāgapallavitahṛdayena rājavāhanena pūrvasaṃketasamāgatām anekabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgīm avantisundarīṃ vaivāhikamantratantranaipuṇyenāgniṃ sākṣīkṛtya saṃyojayāmāsa
tadākarṇya roṣāruṇitanetro mantrī lāṭapatiḥ kaḥ tena maitrī kā punarasya varākasya sevayā kiṃ labhyam iti tānnirabhartsayat te ca mānapālenoktaṃ vipralāpaṃ mattakālāya tathaivākathayan

ekadā hitaiḥ suhṛnmantripurohitaiḥ sabhāyāṃ siṃhāsanāsīno guṇair ahīno lalāṭataṭanyastāñjalinā dvārapālena vyajñāpi deva devasaṃdarśanalālasamānasaḥ ko'pi devena viracyārcanārho yatir dvāradeśam adhyāsta iti
śūraṃ kṛtajñaṃ dṛḍhasauhṛdaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ vāñchati vāsahetoḥ
sarvadravyeṣu vidyaiva dravyam āhur anuttamam
bhadramandrair bhadramṛgair mṛgamandraiś ca sā purī
tulyā bhavaddarśanasampad eṣā vṛṣṭer divo vītabalāhakāyāḥ
tena sarvārthasiddhirvā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
tatra hetitatihatiśrāntā amātyā daivagatyānutkrāntajīvitā niśāntavātalabdhasaṃjñāḥ kathaṃcid āśvasya rājānaṃ samantād anvīkṣyānavalokitavanto dainyavanto devīmavāpuḥ

paśyatu patimadyaiva śūlāvataṃsitamiyamanāryaśīlā kulapāṃsanī iti nirbhartsayan bhīṣaṇabhrukuṭidūṣitalalāṭaḥ kāla iva kālalohadaṇḍakarkaśena bāhudaṇḍenāvalambya hastāmbuje rekhāmbujarathāṅgalāñchane rājaputraṃ sarabhasamācakarṣa
siṃhau bhaviṣyataḥ pāpau svecchācārau yuvām iti

vañcayitvā vayasyagaṇaṃ samāgato rājavāhanastadavalokanakautūhalena bhuvaṃ gamiṣṇuḥ kālindīdattaṃ kṣutpipāsādikleśanāśanaṃ maṇiṃ sāhāyyakaraṇasaṃtuṣṭān mataṅgāllabdhvā kaṃcanādhvānam anuvartamānaṃ taṃ visṛjya bilapathena tena niryayau
viṣṇoḥ svarūpāt parato hi te 'nye rūpe pradhānaṃ puruṣaś ca vipra
kumārā mārābhirāmā rāmādyapauruṣā ruṣā bhasmīkṛtārayo rayopahasitasamīraṇā raṇābhiyānena yānenābhyudayāśaṃsaṃ rājānamakārṣuḥ
tadālocya niścitatatkṛtyairamātyai rājā vijñāpito 'bhūd deva nirupāyena devasahāyena yoddhumarātirāyāti

nirjane vane kiṃnimittaṃ rudyate tvayā iti pṛṣṭā sā karasaroruhairaśru pramṛjya sagadgadaṃ māmavocan mune lāvaṇyajitapuṣpasāyake mithilānāyake kīrtivyāptasudharmaṇi nijasuhṛdo magadharājasya sīmantinīsīmantamahotsavāya putradārasamanvite puṣpapuramupetya kaṃcana kālam adhivasati samārādhitagirīśo mālavādhīśo magadharājaṃ yoddhumabhyagāt

tatra saṃtatam evaṃvidhavijayasiddhaye kumāraṃ devatopahāraṃ kariṣyantaḥ kirātāḥ mahīruhaśākhāvalambitam enam asilatayā vā saikatatale khanananikṣiptacaraṇaṃ lakṣīkṛtya śitaśaranikareṇa vā anekacaraṇaiḥ palāyamānaṃ kukkurabālakairvā daṃśayitvā saṃhaniṣyāmaḥ iti bhāṣamāṇā mayā samabhyabhāṣanta nanu kirātottamāḥ ghorapracāre kāntāre skhalitapathaḥ sthavirabhūsuro 'haṃ mama putrakaṃ kvacicchāyāyāṃ nikṣipya mārgānveṣaṇāya kiṃcid antaram agaccham
yakṣeśvarānumatyā madātmajametaṃ bhavattanūjasyāmbhonidhivalayaveṣṭitakṣoṇīmaṇḍaleśvarasya bhāvino viśuddhayaśonidhe rājavāhanasya paricaryākaraṇāyānītavatyasmi
muktājālaiḥ stanaparisaracchinnasūtraiś ca hārair naiśo mārgaḥ savitur udaye sūcyate kāminīnām
tadvadahamapyugraṃ tapo viracya tam arātim unmūlayiṣyāmi lokaśaraṇyena bhavatkāruṇyeneti niyamavantaṃ bhavantaṃ prāpnavam iti
śabdāyante madhuram anilaiḥ kīcakāḥ pūryamāṇāḥ saṃraktābhis tripuravijayo gīyate kiṃnarībhiḥ
anārataṃ tena padeṣu lambhitā vibhajya samyag viniyogasatkriyām
tasya vṛkṣasyādhastād vivare sarpas tiṣṭhati
granthavistarasaṃkṣepamātraṃ bhāṣā ca bhidyate
agūḍhabhāvāpi vilokane sā na locane mīlayituṃ viṣehe
tābhyo mokṣas tava yadi sakhe gharmalabdhasya na syāt krīḍālolāḥ śravaṇaparuṣair garjitair bhāyayes tāḥ
athaikadā varṣāsu nīlapaṭair iva jaladharapaṭalair āvṛte nabhastale
nirapekṣo na kartavyo bhṛtyaiḥ svāmī kadācana
baddhasnehā dadhatyāśāmeṣo 'smāñjīvayediti
viṣaṇṇavadanaḥ śāmbo jīviteśvarīvirahasahiṣṇurbhūmau daṇḍavatpraṇamya savinayamabhāṣata mahābhāga yadajñānenākaravam tatkṣamasva iti
yathā prabhukṛtān mānād yudhyante bhuvi mānavāḥ
anyac ca bhrātaḥ śṛṇu
prajānurāgād dharmāc ca duḥkhocchedyo hi dhārmikaḥ
adho 'dhaḥ paśyataḥ kasya mahimā nopacīyate
tathāpi puṣṇāti nabhaḥ śriyaṃ parāṃ na ramyam āhāryam apekṣate guṇam
brahmavarcasena tulitavedhasaṃ purodhasaṃ puraskṛtya kṛtyavinmahīpatiḥ kumāraṃ sukumāraṃ jātasaṃskāreṇa bālālaṅkāreṇa ca virājamānaṃ rājavāhananāmānaṃ vyadhatta
kulasadṛśam acīkarad yathāvat priyatanayas tanayasya jātakarma
idaṃ bhājanameṣā ca yaṣṭirete ca pāduke
tatas tam ādāyāsau kumbhakārasya bhāṇḍapūrṇamaṇḍapaikadeśe raudreṇākulitaḥ suptaḥ
śīghraṃ samarthāpi tu gantumanyā gatiṃ nijagrāha yayau na tūrṇam

samutsukayā rājakanyayā marālagrahaṇe niyuktāṃ bālacandrikāmavalokya samucito vākyāvasara iti sambhāṣaṇanipuṇo rājavāhanaḥ salīlamalapat sakhi purā śāmbo nāma kaścinmahīvallabho manovallabhayā saha vihāravāñchayā kamalākaramavāpya tatra kokanadakadambasamīpe nidrādhīnamānasaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ śanair gṛhītvā bisaguṇena tasya caraṇayugalaṃ nigaḍayitvā kāntāmukhaṃ sānurāgaṃ vilokayan mandasmitavikasitaikakapolamaṇḍalas tām abhāṣata indumukhi mayā baddho marālaḥ śānto munivadāste
sa ca bhojanāvaśiṣṭabhikṣānnasahitaṃ bhikṣāpātraṃ nāgadantake 'vasthāpya svapiti
anupagatajarāḥ payasvinīr gāḥ svayamadadātsutavṛddhaye dvijebhyaḥ
maivaṃ kṛthā nṛpasyecchā setsyatyevetyavārayat
tāsāṃ tadā sasvanabhūṣaṇānāṃ vātāyaneṣvapraśamo babhūva

tatra purato bhayaṅkarajvālākulahutabhugavagāhanasāhasikāṃ mukulitāñjalipuṭāṃ vanitāṃ kāṃcid avalokya sasaṃbhramam analād apanīya kūjantyā vṛddhayā saha matpitur abhyarṇam abhigamayya sthavirāmavocam vṛddhe bhavatyau kutratye

paredyuḥ prabhāte vidyeśvaro rasabhāvarītigaticaturastādṛśena mahatā nijaparijanena saha rājabhavanadvārāntikamupetya dauvārikaniveditanijavṛttāntaḥ sahasopagamya sapraṇāmam aindrajālikaḥ samāgataḥ iti dvāḥsthair vijñāpitena taddarśanakutūhalāviṣṭena samutsukāvarodhasahitena mālavendreṇa samāhūyamāno vidyeśvaraḥ kakṣāntaraṃ praviśya savinayam āśiṣaṃ dattvā tadanujñātaḥ parijanatāḍyamāneṣu vādyeṣu nadatsu gāyakīṣu madanakalakokilāmañjuladhvaniṣu samadhikarāgarañjitasāmājikamanovṛttiṣu picchikābhramaṇeṣu saparivāraṃ parivṛttaṃ bhrāmayanmukulitanayanaḥ kṣaṇamatiṣṭhat
tvām āsādya stanitasamaye mānayiṣyanti siddhāḥ sotkampāni priyasahacarīsambhramāliṅgitāni

tasyā manogatam rāgodrekaṃ manmanorathasiddhyantarāyaṃ ca niśamya bāṣpapūrṇalocanāṃ tāmāśvāsya dāruvarmaṇo maraṇopāyaṃ ca vicārya vallabhām avocam taruṇi bhavadabhilāṣiṇaṃ duṣṭahṛdayamenaṃ nihantuṃ mṛdurupāyaḥ kaścin mayā cintyate
samāruruhurātmānaṃ kumāragrahaṇaṃ prati
kṣipraṃ vibho brūhi na me 'sti śāntiḥ snehaṃ sute vetsi hi bāndhavānām
sadarpo 'py uragaḥ kīṭair bahubhir nāśyate dhruvam
mune vakṣyāmy ahaṃ buddhvā tair yuktaḥ śrūyatāṃ naraḥ
paśyantyāstaṃ nṛpaṃ tasyā lajjākautukayordṛśi
vimucyamānair api tasya mantharaṃ gavāṃ himānīviśadaiḥ kadambakaiḥ
saṃjīvako brūte tadabhayavācaṃ me yaccha
purādhirūḍhaḥ śayanaṃ mahādhanaṃ vibodhyase yaḥ stutigītimaṅgalaiḥ
udyateṣv api śastreṣu dūto vadati nānyathā
nipānam iva maṇḍūkāḥ saraḥ pūrṇam ivāṇḍajāḥ
damanako brūte yadi svāmitrāsas tatraiva mucyate tadā katham ayaṃ mahāprasādalābhaḥ syāt

tejomayo 'yaṃ mānuṣamātrapauruṣo nūnaṃ na bhavati iti matvā sa puruṣas tadvayasyamukhānnāmajanane vijñāya tasmai nijavṛttāntam akathayad rājanandana kecidasyāmaṭavyāṃ vedādividyābhyāsam apahāya nijakulācāraṃ dūrīkṛtya satyaśaucādidharmavrātaṃ parihṛtya kilbiṣam anviṣyantaḥ pulindapurogamāstadannam upabhuñjānā bahavo brāhmaṇabruvā nivasanti teṣu kasyacitputro nindāpātracāritro mātaṅgo nāmāhaṃ sahakirātabalena janapadaṃ praviśya grāmeṣu dhaninaḥ strībālasahitānānīyāṭavyāṃ bandhane nidhāya teṣāṃ sakaladhanamapaharann uddhato vītadayo vyacaram
ity uktavantaṃ vraja sādhayeti pramāṇayan vākyam ajātaśatroḥ
hastināṃ gamanaṃ proktaṃ praśastaṃ jaladāgame
gatvā cordhvaṃ daśamukhabhujocchvāsitaprasthasaṃdheḥ kailāsasya tridaśavanitādarpaṇasyātithiḥ syāḥ
bāle kaściddivyadehadhārī mānavo navo vallabhastava bhūtvā sakalaṃ rasātalaṃ pālayiṣyati iti

ahamapi sabahumānaṃ mantridattāni bahulaturaṅgamopetaṃ caturasārathiṃ rathaṃ dṛḍhataraṃ kavacaṃ madanurūpaṃ cāpaṃ ca vividhabāṇapūrṇaṃ tūṇīradvayaṃ raṇasamucitānyāyudhāni gṛhītvā yuddhasaṃnaddho madīyabalaviśvāsena ripūddharaṇodyuktaṃ mantriṇamanvagām
āpadarthe dhanaṃ rakṣed dārān rakṣed dhanair api
āvayor yodhamukhyābhyāṃ madarthaḥ sādhyatām iti
bho rājaputrāḥ śṛṇuta
kṛtakṛtyasya bhṛtyasya kṛtaṃ naiva praṇāśayet
gaganādevam udabhūd aśarīrā sarasvatī

tasyā me nabhasi nalinalubdhamugdhakalahaṃsānubaddhavaktrāyās tannivāraṇakṣobhavicchinnavigalitā hārayaṣṭiryadṛcchayā jātu haimavate mandodake magnonmagnasya maharṣermārkaṇḍeyasya mastake maṇikiraṇadviguṇitapalitamapatat
āśāvate ca abhigatāya sadyas deya ambubhiḥ tarṣam acechidiṣṭa
veśyās tvatto nakhapadasukhān prāpya varṣāgrabindūn āmokṣyante tvayi madhukaraśreṇidīrghān kaṭākṣān
tāsāmevaṃvidhānāṃ vo viyuktānāṃ svagocare
sā mūrtimatīva lakṣmīrmālaveśakanyakā svenaivārādhyamānaṃ saṃkalpitavarapradānāyāvirbhūtaṃ mūrtimantaṃ manmathamiva tamālokya mandamārutāndolitā lateva madanāveśavatī cakampe
sthāna eva niyojyante bhṛtyāś cābharaṇāni ca
tasyākṣiṇī nirnimiṣe viśāle snigdhe ca dīpte vimale tathaiva
tālaiḥ śiñjāvalayasubhagair nartitaḥ kāntayā me yām adhyāste divasavigame nīlakaṇṭhaḥ suhṛd vaḥ
garbhādhānakṣaṇaparicayān nūnam ābaddhamālāḥ seviṣyante nayanasubhagaṃ khe bhavantaṃ balākāḥ
nipatya pādayostābhyāṃ jayayā saha bodhitā
jālodgīrṇair upacitavapuḥ keśasaṃskāradhūpair bandhuprītyā bhavanaśikhibhir dattanṛtyopahāraḥ
jñāyate sarvavidyānāṃ mukhaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ naraiḥ
pakṣiśāvakāś cātra nivasanti
kanakabhūṣaṇasaṃgrahaṇocito yadi maṇis trapuṇi praṇidhīyate
tadālocya niścitatatkṛtyairamātyai rājā vijñāpito 'bhūd deva nirupāyena devasahāyena yoddhumarātirāyāti

janapatirekasmin puṇyadivase tīrthasnānāya pakkaṇanikaṭamārgeṇa gacchannabalayā kayācidupalālitamanupamaśarīraṃ kumāraṃ kaṃcid avalokya kutūhalākulastām apṛcchad bhāmini ruciramūrtiḥ sarājaguṇasaṃpūrtir asāvarbhako bhavadanvayasaṃbhavo na bhavati kasya nayanānandaḥ nimittena kena bhavadadhīno jātaḥ kathyatāṃ yāthātathyena tvayeti
tatas tau damanakakaraṭakau rājñā sarvasvenāpi pūjitau bhayapratīkāraṃ pratijñāya calitau
kāntāre nimittena kena duravasthānubhūyate
athavā dānamānābhyāṃ vāsitaṃ dhanadaṃ hi tat
asti hastināpure vilāso nāma rajakaḥ
iti bhṛtyavicārajño bhṛtyair āpūryate nṛpaḥ
tasyānucaraiś caradbhiḥ pakṣibhir ahaṃ dagdhāracyamadhye carann avalokitaḥ
vijitāmarapure puṣpapure nivasatā sānantabhogalālitā vasumatī vasumatīva magadharājena yathāsukham anvabhāvi
atha kadācittadagramahiṣī devī devena kalpavallīphalamāpnuhi iti prabhātasamaye susvapnam avalokitavatī
dhairyeṇa viśvāsyatayā maharṣes tīvrād arātiprabhavācca manyoḥ
eṣa śrutadharo jāto vidyāṃ varṣādavāpsyati
saubhāgyaṃ te subhaga virahāvasthayā vyañjayantī kārśyaṃ yena tyajati vidhinā sa tvayaivopapādyaḥ
ātmānaṃ manyate prītaṃ bhūpālasya sa durmatiḥ

roṣarūkṣeṇa niṭilākṣeṇa bhasmīkṛtacetane makaraketane tadā bhayenānavadyā vaniteti matvā tasya rolambāvalī keśajālam premākaro rajanīkaro vijitāravindavadanam jayadhvajāyamāno mīno jāyāyuto 'kṣiyugalam sakalasainikāṅgavīro malayasamīro niḥśvāsaḥ pathikahṛddalanakaravālaḥ pravālaścādhārabimbam jayaśaṅkho bandhurā lāvaṇyadharā kandharā pūrṇakumbhau cakravākānukārau payodharau jyāyamāne mārdavāsamāne bisalate ca bāhū īṣadutphullalīlāvataṃsakahlārakorakau gaṅgāvartasanābhir nābhiḥ dūrīkṛtayogimanoratho jaitraratho 'tighanaṃ jaghanam jayastambhabhūte saundaryabhūte vighnitayatijanārambhe rambhe coruyugam ātapatrasahasrapatraṃ pādadvayam astrabhūtāni prasūnāni tānītarāṇyaṅgāni ca samabhūvanniva
prasaheta raṇe tavānujān dviṣatāṃ kaḥ śatamanyutejasaḥ
yodhānām agnikalpānāṃ peśalānām amarṣiṇām
bandhupālaśakunanirdiṣṭe divase 'sminnirgatya purādbahirvartamāno netrotsavakāri bhavadavalokanasukhamanubhavāmi iti
śeṣe tvam eva govinda cintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ
atha brāhmaṇāya rājñaḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ dātum āhvānam āgatam

yā vasantasahāyena samutsukatayā rate kelīśālabhañjikāvidhitsayā kaṃcana nārīviśeṣaṃ viracyātmanaḥ krīḍākāsāraśāradāravindasaundaryeṇa pādadvayam udyānavanadīrghikāmattamarālikāgamanarītyā līlālasagativilāsaṃ tūṇīralāvaṇyena jaṅghe līlāmandiradvārakadalīlālityena manojñamūruyugaṃ jaitrarathacāturyeṇa ghanaṃ jaghanam kiṃcidvikasallīlāvataṃsakahlārakorakakoṭarānuvṛttyā gaṅgāvartasanābhiṃ nābhiṃ saudhārohaṇaparipāṭyā valitrayaṃ maurvīmadhukarapaṅktinīlimalīlayā romāvalim pūrṇasuvarṇakalaśaśobhayā kucadvandvaṃ latāmaṇḍapasaukumāryeṇa bāhū jayaśaṅkhābhikhyayā kaṇṭhaṃ kamanīyakarṇapūrasahakārapallavarāgeṇa pratibimbīkṛtabimbaṃ radanacchadanaṃ bāṇāyamānapuṣpalāvaṇyena śuci smitam agradūtikākalakaṇṭhikākalālāpamādhuryeṇa vacanajātaṃ sakalasainikanāyakamalayamārutasaurabhyeṇa niḥśvāsapavanam jayadhvajamīnadarpeṇa locanayugalaṃ cāpayaṣṭiśriyā bhrūlate prathamasuhṛdasudhākarasyāpanītakalaṅkayā kāntyā vadanaṃ līlāmayūrabarhabhaṅgyā keśapāśaṃ ca vidhāya samastamakarandakastūrikāsaṃmitena malayajarasena prakṣālya karpūraparāgeṇa saṃmṛjya nirmiteva rarāja
gharmānte 'smin vigaṇaya kathaṃ vāsarāṇi vrajeyur diksaṃsaktapravitataghanavyastasūryātapāni

athaikadā vāmadevaḥ sakalakalākuśalena kusumasāyakasaṃśayitasaundaryeṇa kalpitasodaryeṇa sāhasāpahasitakumāreṇa sukumāreṇa jayadhvajātapavāraṇakuliśāṅkitakareṇa kumāranikareṇa pariveṣṭitaṃ rājānamānataśirasaṃ samabhigamya tena tāṃ kṛtāṃ paricaryāmaṅgīkṛtya nijacaraṇakamalayugalamilanmadhukarāyamāṇakākapakṣaṃ vidaliṣyamāṇavipakṣaṃ kumāracayaṃ gāḍhamāliṅgya mitasatyavākyena vihitāśīr abhyabhāṣata
martavyam iti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate
krameṇa garbhādabhiniḥsṛtaḥ san babhau cyutaḥ khādiva yonyajātaḥ
yadā kelivane kuraṅgalocanā locanapathamavartata tadaiṣāpahṛtamadīyamānasā sā svamandiramagāt
aṭavyāṃ drakṣyasi bhrāmyansiṃhārūḍhaṃ kumārakam
ścyotanmayūkhe 'pi himadyutau me nanirvṛtaṃ nirvṛtim eti cakṣuḥ
tasya atikrame lokaḥ saṃkarāt ucchidyeta
jātau jātismarāvāvāṃ haṃsau hemamayau tataḥ
satraṃ te viramatv etat kṣamāsārā hi sādhavaḥ
jātidravyabalānāṃ ca sāmyam eṣāṃ mayā saha
yattavābhīṣṭaṃ yena priyāmanorathaḥ phaliṣyati tadakhilaṃ kariṣyāmi
siṃhau bhaviṣyataḥ pāpau svecchācārau yuvām iti
nāsty eva taccandanapādapasya yan nāśritaṃ duṣṭataraiś ca hiṃsraiḥ
nipatya pādayostābhyāṃ jayayā saha bodhitā
śobhitaṃ lakṣaṇairdīptaiḥ sahajairbhūṣaṇairiva
so 'pi lalāṭataṭacumbadañjalipuṭaḥ savinayamalapat
imau munī pārthivalakṣmaṇānvitau kuśīlavau caiva mahātapasvinau

tataḥ sakalalipijñānaṃ nikhiladeśīyabhāṣāpāṇḍityaṣaḍaṅgasahitavedasamudāyakovidatvaṃ kāvyanāṭakākhyānakākhyāyiketihāsacitrakathāsahitapurāṇagaṇanaipuṇyaṃ dharmaśabdajyotistarkamīmāṃsādisamastaśāstranikaracāturyaṃ kauṭilyakāmandakīyādinītipaṭalakauśalaṃ vīṇādyaśeṣavādyadākṣyaṃ saṃgītasāhityahāritvaṃ maṇimantrauṣadhādimāyāprapañcacuñcutvaṃ mātaṅgaturaṅgādivāhanārohaṇapāṭavaṃ vividhāyudhaprayogacaṇatvaṃ cauryadurodarādikapaṭakalāprauḍhatvaṃ ca tattadācāryebhyaḥ samyaglabdhvā yauvanena vilasantaṃ kumāranikaraṃ nirīkṣya mahīvallabhaḥ saḥ 'haṃ śatrujanadurlabhaḥ iti paramānandamamandamavindata
anyedyuḥ kaṃcana bālakamurasi dadhatī vasumatī vallabham abhigatā
varṣopavarṣau tadbuddhvā sādhvīṃ tāmabhyanandatām
nyasyatāṃ kalaśas tāta dīyatāṃ valkalaṃ mama
tatas te dhūrtāḥ yady eṣa chāgaḥ kenāpy upāyena labhyate tadā matiprakarṣo bhavatīti samālocya vṛkṣatrayatale krośāntareṇa tasya brāhmaṇasyāgamanaṃ pratīkṣya pathi sthitāḥ
tābhir dharmārthau yad vidyāt tad vidyānāṃ vidyātvam
āstāṃ mānasatuṣṭaye sukṛtināṃ nītir navoḍheva vaḥ kalyāṇaṃ kurutāṃ janasya bhagavāṃś candrārdhacūḍāmaṇiḥ
śāpānto me bhujagaśayanād utthite śārṅgapāṇau śeṣān māsān gamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
punaḥ siṃho 'bravīdetamṛkṣaṃ me kṣipa mānuṣa
kadācidekasmin kāntāre madīyasahacaragaṇena jighāṃsyamānaṃ bhūsuramekamavalokya dayāyattacitto 'bravam nanu pāpāḥ na hantavyo brāhmaṇa iti
yato 'nena rājñā vināparādhena ciram avadhīritābhyām āvābhyāṃ mahadduḥkham anubhūtam
na daivam api saṃcintya tyajed udyogam ātmanaḥ
gokarṇasadṛśau kṛtvā karāvābaddhasāraṇau
martyo bhavāvinīteti vihvalaṃ taṃ śaśāpa sā
tadasau svakīyena karmaṇā nihataḥ
tatsadā dehi viprebhyo yenāyānti niśamya te
jñānalavadurvidagdhaṃ brahmāpi naraṃ na rañjayati
pradyotasya priyaduhitaraṃ vatsarājo 'tra jahre haimaṃ tāladrumavanam abhūd atra tasyaiva rājñaḥ
tadyathā tilako jñātastathā sarvamidaṃ mayā
tāvad ūrdhvam adhaś ca tvaṃ mallokeṣu nivatsyasi
tataḥ kumāro jarayābhibhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā narebhyaḥ pṛthagākṛtiṃ tam
rājāha durgānusandhāne ko niyujyatām
sūryaḥ sa evābhyadhikaṃ cakāśe jajvāla saumyārcir anīrito 'gniḥ
nandigrāme jaṭāṃ hitvā bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito 'naghaḥ
kṣaṇena cādrākṣīttadapisainyamanyena samantato 'bhimukhamabhidhāvatā balanikāyena parikṣiptam
kanyākumārāvevam anyonyapurātanajanananāmadheye paricite parasparajñānāya sābhijñamuktvā manojarāgapūrṇamānasau babhūvatuḥ
namas te paramātmātman puruṣātman namo 'stu te
tatsaṃpratyatra rakṣāmi tasya dehamapīdṛśam
kriyāpavargeṣv anujīvisātkṛtāḥ kṛtajñatām asya vadanti sampadaḥ
vihāya lakṣmīpatilakṣma kārmukaṃ jaṭādharaḥ sañ juhudhīha pāvakam
sā sasaṃbhramam āgatyāmandahṛdayānandasaṃphullavadanāravindā tam upoṣitābhyām ivānimiṣitābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ pibantī vikasvareṇa svareṇa purohitāmātyajanam uccairāhūya tebhyastamadarśayat
tadanubhāvaniruddhanigrahecchāstu sadya eva te tamarthaṃ caṇḍavarmaṇe nivedayāṃcakruḥ
munikanyā ca sā śāpāttasyāṃ jātāvavātarat
taiś coktaṃ purukutsāya bhūbhuje narmadātaṭe
tadanu so 'haṃ tvarayā kiṃcid antaram agamam
nāmnā pāṭaliputraṃ kṣetraṃ lakṣmīsarasvatyoḥ
hiraṇyako vihasyāha kā tvayā saha maitrī yataḥ yad yena yujyate loke budhas tat tena yojayet
aho 'tidhīraṃ balavacca te manaścaleṣu kāmeṣu ca sāradarśinaḥ
priyeṣu yaiḥ pārtha vinopapatter vicintyamānaiḥ klamam eti cetaḥ
śrutvā tataḥ strījanavallabhānāṃ manojñabhāvaṃ purakānanānām
āpatsu mitraṃ jānīyād raṇe śūram ṛṇe śucim

vivekaśūnyamatirasau rāgātirekeṇa ratnakhacitahemaparyaṅke haṃsatūlagarbhaśayanamānīya taruṇīṃ tasyai mahyaṃ tamisrāsamyaganavalokitapumbhāvāya manoramastrīveśāya ca cāmīkaramaṇimaṇḍanāni sūkṣmāṇi citravastrāṇi kastūrikāmilitaṃ haricandanaṃ karpūrasahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃ surabhīṇi kusumānītyādivastujātaṃ samarpya muhūrtadvayamātraṃ hāsavacanaiḥ saṃlapannatiṣṭhat
rājā niṭilataṭacumbitanijacaraṇāmbujaiḥ praśaṃsitadaivamāhātmyair amātyair abhāṇi deva rathyacayaḥ sārathyapagame rathaṃ rabhasādaraṇyamanayad iti
hā hā putraka nādhītaṃ gatāsv etāsu rātriṣu
rakṣitaṃ vardhayec caiva vṛddhaṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet
bhrātarau svarasampannau gandharvāv iva rūpiṇau
atha kadācittadagramahiṣī devī devena kalpavallīphalamāpnuhi iti prabhātasamaye susvapnam avalokitavatī
śaradabhracalāś calendriyair asurakṣā hi bahucchalāḥ śriyaḥ
nanu vaktṛviśeṣaniḥspṛhā guṇagṛhyā vacane vipaścitaḥ
tatra vivṛtavadanaḥ ko'pi rūpī kopa iva vyāghraḥ śīghraṃ māmāghrātumāgatavān
kṣaṇena cādrākṣīttadapisainyamanyena samantato 'bhimukhamabhidhāvatā balanikāyena parikṣiptam
sajjanaiḥ saṃgataṃ kuryād dharmāya ca sukhāya ca
karaṭako brūte atha tatra gatvā kiṃ vakṣyati bhavān
tasya vasumatī nāma sumatī līlāvatīkulaśekharamaṇī ramaṇī babhūva
sparśakliṣṭām ayamitanakhenāsakṛtsārayantīṃ gaṇḍābhogāt kaṭhinaviṣamām ekaveṇīṃ kareṇa
sā yojane ca dve bhūyaḥ satyanāmā prakāśate
tato 'sau yāvad asmaddurgadvārarodhaṃ na karoti tāvan nadyadrivanavartmasu tadbalāni hantuṃ sārasādayaḥ senāpatayo niyujyantām
prahasatyatha tatrasthe jane kiṃcidvicintya saḥ
praṇidhānādatha jñātvā jagādaivamumāpatiḥ
yathā hiraṇyaṃ śuci dhātumadhye merurgirīṇāṃ sarasāṃ samudraḥ
praṇatipravaṇān vihāya naḥ sahajasnehanibaddhacetasaḥ
astabdhatvam acāpalyaṃ pratyakṣenāvagamyate
hitvā tasmin bhujagavalayaṃ śambhunā dattahastā krīḍāśaile yadi ca vicaret pādacāreṇa gaurī
sārdhaṃ tayāsau vijahāra rājā nācintayadvaiśravaṇasya lakṣmīm
yato 'nujīvinā parādhikāracarcā sarvathā na kartavyā
ānvīkṣikī trayī vārttā daṇḍanītiśceti vidyāḥ
budhais tyakte rājye na hi bhavati nītir guṇavatī vipannāyāṃ nītau sakalam avaśaṃ sīdati jagat
taṃ vilokya bhītā sā bālakaṃ nipātya prādravat
pāyūpasthau karau pādau vāk ca maitreya pañcamī
saṃtaptānāṃ tvamasi śaraṇaṃ tatpayoda priyāyāḥ saṃdeśaṃ me hara dhanapatikrodhaviśleṣitasya
purāvṛttakathodgāraiḥ kathaṃ nirṇīyate paraḥ

tadanu tadanucarāḥ kalyena sākalye rājakumāramanavalokayanto viṣaṇṇahṛdayāsteṣu teṣu vaneṣu samyag anviṣyānavekṣamāṇā etadanveṣaṇamanīṣayā deśāntaraṃ cariṣṇavo 'tisahiṣṇavo niścitapunaḥsaṃketasthānāḥ parasparaṃ viyujya yayuḥ
kāṇabhūtau tadā mukte kathāṃ prakhyāpya mokṣyate
jñāto 'si śakaṭālena tadenaṃ cintayādhunā
evamastviti tattasmādgṛhītvā vadhakā gatāḥ
rājā ghṛṇī brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhakṣī strī cāvajñā duṣprakṛtiḥ sahāyaḥ
anudyogena tailāni tilebhyo nāptum arhati
iti bahu vilapya hiraṇyakaś citrāṅgalaghupatanakāv āha yāvad ayaṃ vyādho vanān na niḥsarati tāvan mantharaṃ mocayituṃ yatnaḥ kriyatām
paritaḥ paṭu bibhrad enasāṃ dahanaṃ dhāma vilokanakṣamam
gṛhasthasya svadharma ājīvaḥ tulyaiḥ asamāna ṛṣibhiḥ vaivāhyam ṛtugāmi tvam deva pitṛ atithi pūjā bhṛtyeṣu tyāgaḥ śeṣa bhojanam ca
juhāva havyāni akṛśe kṛśānau
tuṣeṇāpi parityaktā na prarohanti taṇḍulāḥ
phalena manasā vācā dṛṣṭyā cainaṃ praharṣayet
vācayitvā ca taṃ lekhamekānte śivavarmaṇe
asmaddevapādāravindaṃ praṇama
sa cāsya kathayāmāsa śabarīṃ dharmacāriṇīm
yo yatra kuśalaḥ kārye taṃ tatra viniyojayet
tacchrutvā mama rājñaśca viṣādapramadau dvayoḥ
atrāntare saṃjīvako vadati deva adya hatamṛgāṇāṃ māṃsāni kva
tena ca tatra siṃhenānanubhūtapūrvakam akālaghanagarjitam iva saṃjīvakanarditam aśrāvi
rājahaṃso brūte kati prakārāḥ sandhīnāṃ sambhavanti
tad eteṣām asmatputrāṇāṃ nītiśāstropadeśāya bhavantaḥ pramāṇam ity uktvā tasya viṣṇuśarmaṇo bahumānapuraḥsaraṃ putrān samarpitavān
tasyākṣiṇī nirnimiṣe viśāle snigdhe ca dīpte vimale tathaiva
yathā saṃnidhimātreṇa gandhaḥ kṣobhāya jāyate
āvirbhūya mayā coktau varaḥ ko 'pyarthyatāmiti
analpena ca pāpmanā rajataśṛṅkhalībhūtāṃ māmaikṣvākasya rājño vegavataḥ pautraḥ putro mānasavegasya vīraśekharo nāma vidyādharaḥ śaṅkaragirau samadhyagamat
bhṛśaṃ dadarśāśramamaṇḍapopamāḥ sapuṣpahāsāḥ sa niveśavīrudhaḥ
tadavadhārya kāryajño rājā munikathitaṃ dvitīyaṃ rājakumārameva niścitya sāmadānābhyāṃ tām anunīyāpahāravarmetyākhyāya devyai vardhayeti samarpitavān
ekaikaḥ kāṣṭhikaḥ prītyā kāṣṭhe dve dve dadau mama
atha vakti sma taṃ mantrī hanyeyaṃ yatra bhūpate
jagatyayaṃ mohatamo nihantuṃ jvaliṣyati jñānamayo hi sūryaḥ
śrutvā kaḥ pratyayo 'treti vatsagulmāvavocatām
sādhanābhilāṣiṇo mama toṣiṇo racaya sāhāyyam iti
ruddhāpāṅgaprasaram alakair añjanasnehaśūnyaṃ pratyādeśād api ca madhuno vismṛtabhrūvilāsam
tvatto hi vedādhyayanam adhītam akhilaṃ guro
purāsmin eva sarasy evaṃvidheṣv eva dhīvareṣūpasthiteṣu matsyatrayeṇālocitam
kiṃ tasya jīvitaphalena manuṣyaloke kāko 'pi jīvati cirāya baliṃ ca bhuṅkte
devo 'pi yathā te rocate iti tamābhāṣya gatvā ca tannirdiṣṭena mārgeṇa nagarād bahir atimahato rohiṇadrumasya kasyacitkṣaumāvadātasaikate gaṅgātaraṅgapavanapātaśītale tale dviradādavatatara
tanniśamyābhinanditaparākramo rājavāhanastanniraparādhadaṇḍe daivamupālabhya tasmai krameṇātmacaritaṃ kathayāmāsa
vanāntaśayyākaṭhinīkṛtākṛtī kacācitau viṣvag ivāgajau gajau
idānīṃ kṣīṇaśāpo 'haṃ yatiṣye dehamujhitum
śītavātātapakleśān sahante yān parāśritāḥ
rājavaṃśāñ śataguṇān sthāpayiṣyati rāghavaḥ
tuṣāralekhākulitotpalābhe paryaśruṇī maṅgalabhaṅgabhīruḥ
sugrīvam eva tad rājye rāghavaḥ pratyapādayat
rājā niṭilataṭacumbitanijacaraṇāmbujaiḥ praśaṃsitadaivamāhātmyair amātyair abhāṇi deva rathyacayaḥ sārathyapagame rathaṃ rabhasādaraṇyamanayad iti
ṛkṣastato 'bravītpāpa na mitraṃ ghātayāmyaham
so 'pi markaṭaḥ kvacidagāt
śroṇībhārād alasagamanā stokanamrā stanābhyāṃ yā tatra syād yuvatīviṣaye sṛṣṭir ādyaiva dhātuḥ
daridrāṇāṃ kulīnānāṃ bhāṇḍamūlyaṃ dadāti saḥ
saṃsatsu jāte puruṣādhikāre na pūraṇī taṃ samupaiti saṃkhyā
padmeva lakṣmīḥ pṛthivīva dhīrā māyeti nāmnānupameva māyā
iyaṃ nṛpasya vaṃśaśrīrito na syātparāṅmukhī
abhimānavato manasvinaḥ priyam uccaiḥ padam ārurukṣataḥ
vidyudgarbhaḥ stimitanayanāṃ tvatsanāthe gavākṣe vaktuṃ dhīraḥ stanitavacanair māninīṃ prakramethāḥ
hitvā hālām abhimatarasāṃ revatīlocanāṅkāṃ bandhuprītyā samaravimukho lāṅgalī yāḥ siṣeve
etāvaj janmasāphalyaṃ dehinām iha dehiṣu
pāpiṣṭhairanubhūyamānamatra yātanāviśeṣaṃ vilokya punarapi pūrvaśarīramanena gamyatām iti
madudantamevamākhyāya śirīṣakusumasukumārāyā yathā śarīrabādhā na jāyeta tathāvidhamupāyamācara iti
hiraṇyakaḥ kathayati
sakhīn iva prītiyujo 'nujīvinaḥ samānamānān suhṛdaś ca bandhubhiḥ
garbhabharālasāṃ tāṃ lalanāṃ dhātrībhāvena kalpitāhaṃ karābhyāmudvahantī phalakamekamadhiruhya daivagatyā tīrabhūmimagamam
uparudhyārim āsīta rāṣṭraṃ cāsyopapīḍayet
ahamekāntaniketane muṣṭijānupādāghātaistaṃ rabhasānnihatya punarapi vayasyāmiṣeṇa bhavatīm anu niḥśaṅkaṃ nirgamiṣyāmi
suhṛdaḥ sahajās tathetare matam eṣāṃ na vilaṅghayanti ye
tatra hetitatihatiśrāntā amātyā daivagatyānutkrāntajīvitā niśāntavātalabdhasaṃjñāḥ kathaṃcid āśvasya rājānaṃ samantād anvīkṣyānavalokitavanto dainyavanto devīmavāpuḥ
dhanahīnaḥ svapatnyāpi tyajyate kiṃ punaḥ paraiḥ
ebhiḥ sādho hṛdayanihitair lakṣaṇair lakṣayethā dvāropānte likhitavapuṣau śaṅkhapadmau ca dṛṣṭvā
ekatra vṛkṣe kākavartakau sukhaṃ nivasataḥ

tatra tathāvidhāvasthāmanubhavantīṃ manmathānalasaṃtaptāṃ sukumārīṃ kumārīṃ nirīkṣya khinno vayasyagaṇaḥ kāñcanakalaśasaṃcitāni haricandanośīraghanasāramilitāni tadabhiṣekakalpitāni salilāni bisatantumayāni vāsāṃsi ca nalinīdalamayāni tālavṛntāni ca santāpaharaṇāni bahūni sampādya tasyāḥ śarīram aśiśirayat
āgatyaiva ca vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ mahyaṃ nyavedayat
āstāṃ mānasatuṣṭaye sukṛtināṃ nītir navoḍheva vaḥ kalyāṇaṃ kurutāṃ janasya bhagavāṃś candrārdhacūḍāmaṇiḥ
apakṣayavināśābhyāṃ pariṇāmarddhijanmabhiḥ
kumāraṃ vividhaistaistair upacakramire nayaiḥ
samprati mitralābhaḥ prastūyate
tataḥ sā tatputraṃ kusūlād bahiṣkṛtya darśitavatī
tasminneva kṣaṇe vanyo vāraṇaḥ kaścidadṛśyata

tatra saṃtatam evaṃvidhavijayasiddhaye kumāraṃ devatopahāraṃ kariṣyantaḥ kirātāḥ mahīruhaśākhāvalambitam enam asilatayā vā saikatatale khanananikṣiptacaraṇaṃ lakṣīkṛtya śitaśaranikareṇa vā anekacaraṇaiḥ palāyamānaṃ kukkurabālakairvā daṃśayitvā saṃhaniṣyāmaḥ iti bhāṣamāṇā mayā samabhyabhāṣanta nanu kirātottamāḥ ghorapracāre kāntāre skhalitapathaḥ sthavirabhūsuro 'haṃ mama putrakaṃ kvacicchāyāyāṃ nikṣipya mārgānveṣaṇāya kiṃcid antaram agaccham
idānīṃ svasthānam eva vindhyācalaṃ vyāvṛtya pratigamyatām
taṃ janam asatyasandhaṃ bhagavati vasudhe kathaṃ vahasi
yadi tvā samupekṣeya na bhavenmitratā mayi
tasmāt parokṣavṛttīnāṃ phalaiḥ karma vibhāvayet
so 'bhyagacchan mahātejāḥ śabarīṃ śatrusūdanaḥ
tato 'nudita eva bhāskare caturṣv api durgadvāreṣu pravṛtte yuddhe durgābhyantaragṛheṣv ekadā kākair agninikṣiptaḥ

janapatirekasmin puṇyadivase tīrthasnānāya pakkaṇanikaṭamārgeṇa gacchannabalayā kayācidupalālitamanupamaśarīraṃ kumāraṃ kaṃcid avalokya kutūhalākulastām apṛcchad bhāmini ruciramūrtiḥ sarājaguṇasaṃpūrtir asāvarbhako bhavadanvayasaṃbhavo na bhavati kasya nayanānandaḥ nimittena kena bhavadadhīno jātaḥ kathyatāṃ yāthātathyena tvayeti
sā jalairabhiṣiñcantaṃ rājānamasahā satī
tathānuṣṭhite tathāvidhaṃ kūrmam ālokya sarve gorakṣakāḥ paścād dhāvanti vadanti ca aho mahad āścaryam pakṣibhyāṃ kūrmo nīyate
hiraṇyakaś ca sarvadā apāyaśaṅkayā śatadvāraṃ vivaraṃ kṛtvā nivasati
rājñāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca hi tāni tāni kṛtāni putrairakṛtāni pūrvaiḥ
tad idaṃ vartayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ nikhilam āditaḥ
duḥkham evāsti na sukhaṃ yasmāt tad upalakṣyate
saṃtaptānāṃ tvamasi śaraṇaṃ tatpayoda priyāyāḥ saṃdeśaṃ me hara dhanapatikrodhaviśleṣitasya
ātmanāvagataṃ kṛtvā badhnīyāt pūjayec ca vā
abravīn modakair deva paritāḍaya māmiti
teṣāṃ sitavarmaṇaḥ sumatisatyavarmāṇau dharmapālasya sumantrasumitrakāmapālāḥ padmodbhavasya suśrutaratnodbhavāviti tanayāḥ samabhūvan
prayānti toyāni khurāgravikṣate rasātale 'dhaḥ kṛtaśabdasaṃtatam

lokaikavīreṇa kumāreṇa rakṣyamāṇaḥ saṃtuṣṭāntaraṅgo mātaṅgo 'pi bilaṃ śaśiśekharakathitābhijñānaparijñātaṃ niḥśaṅkaṃ praviśya gṛhītatāmraśāsano rasātalaṃ pathā tenaivopetya tatra kasyacitpattanasya nikaṭe kelīkānanakāsārasya vitatasārasasya samīpe nānāvidheneśaśāsanavidhānopapāditena haviṣā homaṃ viracya pratyūhaparihāriṇi savismayaṃ vilokayati rājavāhane samidhājyasamujjvalite jvalane puṇyagehaṃ dehaṃ mantrapūrvakam āhutīkṛtya taḍitsamānakāntiṃ divyāṃ tanumalabhata
tataḥ pravṛttāsu prītisaṃkathāsu priyavayamyagaṇānuyuktaḥ svasya ca somadattapuṣpodbhevayāścaritam anuvarṇya suhṛdāmapi vṛttāntaṃ krameṇa śrotuṃ kṛtaprastāvastāṃśca taduktāvanvayuṅkta
tato vimānairyuvatīkarālaiḥ kautūhalodghāṭitavātāyanaiḥ
sarvāntaścāriṇāṃ hyetā bhavantyeva ca vikriyāḥ
bhadra nāhaṃ viraktaḥ kiṃtu paśya ayaṃ mūṣiko mamāpakārī sadā pātrasthaṃ bhikṣānnam utplutya bhakṣayati

tataḥ kṣīṇapāpo 'sau svapne darśanaṃ dattvā bhagavadādeśād yakṣeśvareṇādiṣṭo yat tvam adya prātaḥ kṣauraṃ kārayitvā laguḍahastaḥ san svagṛhadvāri nibhṛtaṃ sthāsyasi tato yam evāgataṃ bhikṣukaṃ prāṅgaṇe paśyasi taṃ nirdakṣaṃ laguḍaprahāreṇa haniṣyasi
kapotā ūcuḥ
vāgdaṇḍayoś ca pāruṣyaṃ vyasanāni mahībhujām
anyeṣāṃ caiva jantūnāṃ carāṇām acarāś ca ye
dṛṣṭvā yasyāṃ vipaṇiracitān vidrumāṇāṃ ca bhaṅgān saṃlakṣyante salilanidhayas toyamātrāvaśeṣāḥ
saṃgamaṃ ca samudrasya nalasetoś ca bandhanam

sā sagadgadamavādīt putra kālayavanadvīpe kālaguptanāmno vaṇijaḥ kasyacideṣā sutā suvṛttā nāma ratnodbhavena nijakāntenāgacchantī jaladhau magne pravahaṇe nijadhātryā mayā saha phalakamekamavalambya daivayogena kūlam upetāsannaprasavasamayā kasyāṃcid aṭavyām ātmajam asūta
varaṃ vandhyā bhāryā varam api ca garbheṣu vasatir na vāvidvān rūpadraviṇaguṇayukto 'pi tanayaḥ
tāvad dvitīyaṃ samupasthitaṃ me chidreṣv anarthā bahulībhavanti
jahuḥ kṣipramaviśrambhaṃ madena madanena ca
yat krauñcamithunād ekam avadhīḥ kāmamohitam
dṛṣṭe sūrye punarapi bhavān vāhayedadhvaśeṣaṃ mandāyante na khalu suhṛdām abhyupetārthakṛtyāḥ
pāpiṣṭhairanubhūyamānamatra yātanāviśeṣaṃ vilokya punarapi pūrvaśarīramanena gamyatām iti
yad anayor bhūpālayor vigrahe bhavadvacanam eva nidānam
yo dhruvāṇi parityajya adhruvāṇi niṣevate
tataḥ kṣamyatām
labdhāvakāśo 'vidhyanmāṃ tatra dagdho manobhavaḥ
yaḥ kanakavartanaṃ svacakṣuṣāgatya paśyati sa eva pitur agocaro 'pi māṃ pariṇeṣyatīti manasaḥ saṅkalpaḥ
yathā nṛpatisaukhyeṣu na babandha ratiṃ kvacit
viśīryate svayaṃ hy eṣa daivopahatakas tathā
parāparātman viśvātmañ jaya yajñapate 'nagha
tato 'nudita eva bhāskare caturṣv api durgadvāreṣu pravṛtte yuddhe durgābhyantaragṛheṣv ekadā kākair agninikṣiptaḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi tejastimirayoḥ kutaḥ
ityukto yajñadattena putrakastattathākarot
cakravāko brūte deva praṇidhis tāvat tatra prahīyatām
pārśvayor ubhayor aśvā aśvānāṃ pārśvato rathāḥ
tataḥ sa madanākrānto nivedyānvayanāmanī
janasthair yogibhir devaś cintyamāno 'bjasaṃbhavaḥ
sa ca bhojanaviśeṣair māṃ saṃvardhayiṣyati
na vyāpāraśatenāpi śukavat pāṭhyate bakaḥ
tad adya bhaṭṭārakavāre katham etān dantaiḥ spṛśāmi mitra yadi citte na anyathā manyase tadā prabhāte yat tvayā vaktavyaṃ tat kartavyam iti
kesariṇā kariṇaṃ nihatya kutracid agāmi
samudraṃ kṣobhayāmāsa śarair ādityasaṃnibhaiḥ
svabhāvadveṣād vyāpadayitavyaś ca
takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya āyur marmāṇi rakṣati
vāgbhiḥ lalitaiḥ ca hāvaiḥ madaiḥ sa khelaiḥ madhuraiḥ ca hāsaiḥ tam tatra nāryaḥ ramayāṃbabhūvuḥ bhrū vañcitaiḥ ardha nirīkṣitaiḥ ca
yaśāṃsi ca āpat guṇa gandhavanti
kiṃtu karaṭakādayo 'py āśvāsyantāṃ yasmād āpatpratīkārakāle durlabhaḥ puruṣasamavāyaḥ
tasya pracure'pi vitte 'parān bandhūn atisamṛddhān samīkṣya punar arthavṛddhiḥ karaṇīyeti matir babhūva
ekadāsau rājahaṃsaiḥ suvistīrṇakamalaparyaṅke sukhāsīnaḥ parivāraparivṛtas tiṣṭhati
tataḥ sūryatejasā tanmukhaṃ vyāptam avalokya tadvṛkṣasthitena puṇyaśīlena śucinā rājahaṃsena kṛpayā pakṣau prasārya punas tanmukhe chāyā kṛtā
rājovāca kaḥ prayāsyati dautyena yata evambhūto dūtaḥ kāryaḥ
pūtāśca tā maṅgalakarma cakruḥ śivaṃ yayācuḥ śiśave suraughān
cirakālamabhūma kāṇabhūte vilasadvismayamodamānacittāḥ
śriyaḥ kurūṇām adhipasya pālanīṃ prajāsu vṛttiṃ yam ayuṅkta veditum
na śastreṇa na śāstreṇa sarvathā viṣamāḥ striyaḥ
ādhivyādhiparītāpād adya śvo vā vināśine
śrutvaitaddharṣapatnītas tūrṇaṃ daurgatyahānaye
tasyotsaṅge praṇayina iva srastagaṅgādukūlāṃ na tvaṃ dṛṣṭvā na punar alakāṃ jñāsyase kāmacārin
puruṣau dvau tatastau sa pṛṣṭavān kau yuvām iti
guṇānurāgād iva sakhyam īyivān na bādhate 'sya trigaṇaḥ parasparam
tvaṃ ca jāraḥ pāpamatiḥ manolaulyāt puṣpatāmbūlasadṛśaḥ kadācit sevyase kadācin na sevyase ca
ujjahāra kṣitiṃ kṣipraṃ nyastavāṃś ca mahārṇave
deva mayā tau śaptau pramathavarau kutra bhuvi jātau
kārpaṇyavivarṇavadano madāśāpūrṇamānaso 'vocad agrajanmā mahābhāga sutānetānmātṛhīnānanekairupāyai rakṣannidānīm asmin kudeśe bhaikṣyaṃ sampādya dadadetebhyo vasāmi śivālaye 'sminiti
puṣpadanta pravaktāsi tadā śāpādvimokṣyase
alakṣito yogavaśātpraviveśa sa tatkṣaṇāt
tau ca ciravirahaduḥkhaṃ visṛjyānyonyāliṅganasukhamanvabhūtām
vrajājireṣv ambudanādaśaṅkinīḥ śikhaṇḍinām unmadayatsu yoṣitaḥ
na śastreṇa na śāstreṇa sarvathā viṣamāḥ striyaḥ
sa punaḥ prasādyamānastvatpādapadmadvayasya māsadvayamātraṃ saṃdānatāmetya nistaraṇīyāmimām āpadam aparikṣīṇaśaktitvaṃ cendriyāṇāmakalpayat
lolālako bālako 'pi śabarairādāya kutracid upānīyata
vidhunvantaṃ lalitavanitāḥ sendracāpaṃ sacitrāḥ saṃgītāya prahatamurajāḥ snigdhagambhīraghoṣam
sāraso brūte deva na vaktavyam evaṃ duḥsahaṃ vacaḥ yāvac candrārkau divi tiṣṭhatas tāvad vijayatāṃ devaḥ
tad alam idānīṃ gṛhanarakavāsena vanam eva gacchāmi
tyāgaḥ api teṣām hi anayāya dṛṣṭaḥ
taḍāgodarasaṃsthānāṃ parīvāha ivāmbhasām
vidhunvantaṃ lalitavanitāḥ sendracāpaṃ sacitrāḥ saṃgītāya prahatamurajāḥ snigdhagambhīraghoṣam
rājāha madbalaṃ tāvad avalokayatu mantrī

evaṃ daivamānuṣabalena manorathasāphalyamupeto rājavāhanaḥ sarasamadhuraceṣṭābhiḥ śanaiḥśanairhariṇalocanāyā lajjāmapanayan suratarāgamupanayan raho viśrambhamupajanayan saṃlāpe tadanulāpapīyūṣapānalolaścitracitraṃ cittahāriṇaṃ caturdaśabhuvanavṛttāntaṃ śrāvayāmāsa
vidyādharāṇāṃ caritam atas te varṇayāmy aham

paredyuḥ prabhāte vidyeśvaro rasabhāvarītigaticaturastādṛśena mahatā nijaparijanena saha rājabhavanadvārāntikamupetya dauvārikaniveditanijavṛttāntaḥ sahasopagamya sapraṇāmam aindrajālikaḥ samāgataḥ iti dvāḥsthair vijñāpitena taddarśanakutūhalāviṣṭena samutsukāvarodhasahitena mālavendreṇa samāhūyamāno vidyeśvaraḥ kakṣāntaraṃ praviśya savinayam āśiṣaṃ dattvā tadanujñātaḥ parijanatāḍyamāneṣu vādyeṣu nadatsu gāyakīṣu madanakalakokilāmañjuladhvaniṣu samadhikarāgarañjitasāmājikamanovṛttiṣu picchikābhramaṇeṣu saparivāraṃ parivṛttaṃ bhrāmayanmukulitanayanaḥ kṣaṇamatiṣṭhat
pratyujjagmurnṛpasutaṃ prāptaṃ varamiva striyaḥ

tatkṣaṇopasaṃhṛtāliṅganavyatikaraś cāpahāravarmā cāpacakrakaṇapakarpaṇaprāsapaṭṭiśamusalatomarādipraharaṇajātam upayuñjānān balāvaliptān pratibalavīrān bahuprakārāyodhinaḥ parikṣipataḥ kṣitau vicikṣepa
kariṣyase yatra suduścarāṇi prasattaye gotrabhidas tapāṃsi
guṇigaṇagaṇanārambhe na patati kaṭhinī sasambhramād yasya
etaiḥ sandhiṃ na kurvīta vigṛhṇīyāt tu kevalam
ā kailāsādbisakisalayacchedapātheyavantaḥ sampatsyante nabhasi bhavato rājahaṃsāḥ sahāyāḥ
gurubhiryadi budhyeta tatkadācicchivaṃ bhavet
avibhidya niśākṛtaṃ tamaḥ prabhayā nāṃśumatāpy udīyate
dayāviṣṭahṛdayo 'haṃ mantrabalena viṣavyathāmapanetumakṣamaḥ samīpakuñjeṣvauṣadhiviśeṣamanviṣya pratyāgato vyutkrāntajīvitāṃ tāṃ vyalokayam

madvacanasyāmoghatayā bhāvini janane śarīrāntaraṃ gatāyāḥ asyāḥ sarasijākṣyā rasena ramaṇo bhūtvā muhūrtadvayaṃ maccaraṇayugalabandhakāritayā māsadvayaṃ śṛṅkhalānigaḍitacaraṇo ramaṇīviyogaviṣādamanubhūya paścādanekakālaṃ vallabhayā saha rājyasukhaṃ labhasveti
ato brāhmaṇaśāpān maṇḍūkān voḍhum atra tiṣṭhāmi

tallapitāmṛtāśvāsitahṛdayo 'hamanudinaṃ tadupakaṇṭhavartī kadācid indumukhīṃ navayauvanālīḍhāvayavāṃ nayanacandrikāṃ bālacandrikāṃ nāma taruṇīratnaṃ vaṇiṅmandiralakṣmīṃ mūrtāmivāvalokya tadīyalāvaṇyāvadhūtadhīrabhāvo latāntabāṇabāṇalakṣyatāmayāsiṣam
kanyāmekāmapaśyāma kāmasyāstram asāyakam
ato vayaṃ brūmaḥ vyapadeśe'pi siddhiḥ syāt iti
rakṣakaṃ vyasanebhyaś ca mitraṃ jñeyaṃ caturvidham
kautūhalenaiva ca pādapebhyaḥ puṣpāṇyakāle 'pyavapātayadbhiḥ
iti cintāviṣaghno 'yam agadaḥ kiṃ na pīyate
dīnairmanuṣyairanugamyamāno yo bhūṣitaścāpyavarudyate ca
kimeṣa doṣo bhavitā mamāpītyasmai tataḥ sārathirabhyuvāca

tatra ayaṃ mama svāmikumāraḥ iti bandhupālādaye bandhujanāya kathayitvā tena rājavāhanāya bahuvidhāṃ saparyāṃ kārayan sakalakalākuśalo mahīsuravara iti puri prakaṭayan puṣpodbhavo 'muṣya rājño majjanabhojanādikamanudinaṃ svamandire kārayāmāsa
netravaktravikāreṇa lakṣyate'ntargataṃ manaḥ
gambhīrāyāḥ payasi saritaś cetasīva prasanne chāyātmāpi prakṛtisubhago lapsyate te praveśam
tato 'grajanmā narasiṃhasya hiraṇyakaśipordaityeśvarasya vidāraṇamabhinīya mahāścaryānvitaṃ rājānam abhāṣata rājan avasānasamaye bhavatā śubhasūcakaṃ draṣṭumucitam
mama pāśaṃ paścāc chetsyasi
upadeśo hi mūrkhāṇāṃ prakopāya na śāntaye

sa vayasyagaṇādapanīya rahasi punarenam abhāṣata rājan atīte niśānte gaurīpatiḥ svapnasaṃnihito nidrāmudritalocanaṃ vibodhya prasannavadanakāntiḥ praśrayānataṃ māmavocan mātaṅga daṇḍakāraṇyāntarālagāminyās taṭinyās tīrabhūmau siddhasādhyārādhyamānasya sphaṭikaliṅgasya paścād adripatikanyāpadapaṅkticihnitasyāśmanaḥ savidhe vidherānanamiva kimapi bilaṃ vidyate
śuklāpāṅgaiḥ sajalanayanaiḥ svāgatīkṛtya kekāḥ pratudyātaḥ katham api bhavān gantum āśu vyavasyet
śabdavedhyaṃ ca vitataṃ laghuhastā viśāradāḥ
tacchīghram ardhacandro 'sya gale 'smin dīyatām iti
yena śyāmaṃ vapur atitarāṃ kāntim āpatsyate te barheṇeva sphuritarucinā gopaveṣasya viṣṇoḥ
saṃcitasyāpi mahatā vatsa kleśena mānavaiḥ

tatas mahārhāni ca candanāni ratna āvalīḥ ca oṣadhibhiḥ sa garbhāḥ mṛga prayuktān rathakān ca haimān ācakrire asmai suhṛd ālayebhyaḥ vayas anurūpāṇi ca bhūṣaṇāni hiraṇmayān hasti mṛga aśvakān ca rathān ca go putraka samprayuktān putrīḥ ca cāmīkara rūpya citrāḥ
sā lumbinī nāma vanāntabhūmiṃ citradrumāṃ caitrarathābhirāmām
atha śokārtānāṃ vilāpaṃ śrutvā kenacid vṛddhabakenābhihitaṃ bho evaṃ kuruta yūyaṃ matsyān upādāya nakulavivarād ārabhya sarpavivaraṃ yāvatpaṅktikrameṇa ekaikaśo vikirata
asyottamāṃ dharmanadīṃ pravṛttāṃ tṛṣṇārditaḥ pāsyati jīvalokaḥ
mahad utpannam ākhyānaṃ rāmāyaṇam iti śrutam
damanakaḥ prahṛṣṭamanāḥ vijayatāṃ mahārājaḥ śubham astu sarvajagatām ity uktvā yathāsukham avasthitaḥ
māmastamaunaḥ sākūtamavadatsātavāhanaḥ
yac cānyasmai etad vṛttāntakathanaṃ tad apy anucitam

evaṃ mitravṛttāntaṃ niśamyāmlānamānaso rājavāhanaḥ svasya ca somadattasya ca vṛttāntamasmai nivedya somadattaṃ mahākāleśvarārādhanānantaraṃ bhavadvallabhāṃ saparivārāṃ nijakaṭakaṃ prāpayyāgaccha iti niyujya puṣpodbhavena sevyamāno bhūsvargāyamānamavantikāpuraṃ viveśa
vijitāmarapure puṣpapure nivasatā sānantabhogalālitā vasumatī vasumatīva magadharājena yathāsukham anvabhāvi
bālāśokaśca nicito dṛśyatāmeṣa pallavaiḥ
arthasyotpādakaṃ caiva vidadhyān mantriṇaṃ nṛpaḥ
nāgnis tṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ
kāsāṃcidāsāṃ tu varāṅganānāṃ jātatvarāṇāmapi sotsukānām
sodyogaṃ naram āyānti vivaśāḥ sarvasampadaḥ
kim avekṣya phalaṃ payodharān dhvanataḥ prārthayate mṛgādhipaḥ
arthī vararucirme 'stu dāsyāmyasmai ca kāñcanam
teṣu dharmaśīlaḥ satyavarmā saṃsārāsāratāṃ buddhvā tīrthayātrābhilāṣī deśāntaramagamat
kāle kāle bhavati bhavato yasya saṃyogametya snehavyaktiściravirahajaṃ muñcato bāṣpamuṣṇam
tārakāntakamatputraprāptaye prahitaḥ suraiḥ
ā śiraḥ pādamaṅgeṣu tābhistattailakajjalam
guṇānurāgeṇa śirobhir uhyate narādhipair mālyam ivāsya śāsanam
abhedena ca yudhyeta rakṣec caiva parasparam
varṇākārapratidhvānair netravaktravikārataḥ
viveśa vindhyakāntāraṃ viraktaḥ sveṣu bandhuṣu

janapatirekasmin puṇyadivase tīrthasnānāya pakkaṇanikaṭamārgeṇa gacchannabalayā kayācidupalālitamanupamaśarīraṃ kumāraṃ kaṃcid avalokya kutūhalākulastām apṛcchad bhāmini ruciramūrtiḥ sarājaguṇasaṃpūrtir asāvarbhako bhavadanvayasaṃbhavo na bhavati kasya nayanānandaḥ nimittena kena bhavadadhīno jātaḥ kathyatāṃ yāthātathyena tvayeti
etādṛśa eva kaścid bako dvitīyatvena prayātu
akardamam idaṃ tīrthaṃ bharadvāja niśāmaya
pitarau tau sābhijñānamanyonyaṃ jñātvā muditāntarātmānau vinītaṃ mām ānandāśruvarṣeṇābhiṣicya gāḍhamāśliṣya śirasyupāghrāya kasyāṃcinmahīruhacchāyāyām upāviśatām
tadenaṃ dehi gacchāvo vidyādraviṇasiddhaye

tena kutratyo 'yam iti pṛṣṭā samabhāṣata rājan atītāyāṃ rātrau kācana divyavanitā matpurataḥ kumāramenaṃ saṃsthāpya nidrāmudritāṃ māṃ vibodhya vinītābravīd devi tvanmantriṇo dharmapālanandanasya kāmapālasya vallabhā yakṣakanyāhaṃ tārāvalī nāma nandinī maṇibhadrasya
anasūyāsamasyāṃ ca aṅgarāgasya cārpaṇam
kathaṃ tvam etau dhṛtisaṃyamau yamau vilokayann utsahase na bādhitum
sa covāca tataḥ putrānamībhiḥ saktubhiḥ sutāḥ
sā rahasyasaṃjātaviśrambhatayā vihāya lajjābhaye śanairabhāṣata saumya mānasāro mālavādhīśvaro vārdhakyasya prabalatayā nijanandanaṃ darpasāramujjayinyāmabhyaṣiñcat
ahaṃ tu śikṣayāmi tvāṃ varṣaṣaṭkena tadvibho
ity ākarṇyātmanaḥ putrāṇām anadhigataśāstrāṇāṃ nityam unmārgagāmināṃ śāstrānanuṣṭhānenodvignamanāḥ sa rājā cintayāmāsa
tato dineṣu gacchatsu asau pakṣiśāvakān ākramya svakoṭaram ānīya pratyahaṃ khādati
tatastau kasyacidāśrame munerasthāpayam
tṛṣārto duḥkham āpnoti paratreha ca mānavaḥ
citrakūṭam anuprāpya bharadvājasya śāsanāt
yaḥ puṇyastrīratiparimalodgāribhir nāgarāṇām uddāmāni prathayati śilāveśmabhir yauvanāni
tataḥ samutkṣipya dharāṃ svadaṃṣṭrayā mahāvarāhaḥ sphuṭapadmalocanaḥ
dvitīyasya parārdhasya vartamānasya vai dvija
stamberamarayāvadhūtapadātidattartmā ca praviśya veśyābhyantaramadabhrābhranirghoṣagambhīreṇa svareṇābhyadhāt kaḥ sa mahāpuruṣo yenaitan mānuṣamātraduṣkaraṃ mahatkarmānuṣṭhitam

tatra prakhyātayoretayorasaṅkhye saṃkhye vartamāne suhṛtsāhāyyakaṃ kurvāṇo nijabale sati videhe videheśvaraḥ prahāravarmā jayavatā ripuṇābhigṛhya kāruṇyena puṇyena visṛṣṭo hatāvaśeṣeṇa śūnyena sainyena saha svapuragamanamakarot
adhyāsyodapatadvyoma gṛhītvā yaṣṭibhājane
tato 'haṃ rakṣasāṃ satraṃ vināśāya samārabham
dakṣiṇātaḥ suvarṇasya lakṣaṃ tava bhaviṣyati
sṛṣṭisthityantakaraṇād brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikām
bandhupālaśakunanirdiṣṭe divase 'sminnirgatya purādbahirvartamāno netrotsavakāri bhavadavalokanasukhamanubhavāmi iti
yad avocata vīkṣya māninī paritaḥ snehamayena cakṣuṣā
sa supta iva vṛkṣāgrāt patitaḥ pratibudhyate
ātmapakṣaṃ parityajya parapakṣeṣu yo rataḥ
ato 'nanyādṛśādeva pitṝn dānād avāpsyasi
yaḥ kākiṇīm apy apathaprapannāṃ samuddharen niṣkasahasratulyām
tataḥ kṣaṇāt sā mañjūṣā prāpitā bahubhirjanaiḥ
saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ tadvaddeśabhāṣā ca sarvadā
purā kalpakṣaye vṛtte jātaṃ jalamayaṃ jagat
hitvā hālām abhimatarasāṃ revatīlocanāṅkāṃ bandhuprītyā samaravimukho lāṅgalī yāḥ siṣeve
tasya rājñaḥ paramavidheyā dharmapālapadmodbhavasitavarmanāmadheyā dhīradhiṣaṇāvadhīritavibudhācāryavicāryakāryasāhityāḥ kulāmātyāstrayo 'bhūvan
savyāpārām ahani na tathā pīḍayed viprayogaḥ śaṅke rātrau gurutaraśucaṃ nirvinodāṃ sakhīṃ te
idaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiś ca saṃmitam
nīvībandhocchvāsitaśithilaṃ yatra bimbādharāṇāṃ kṣaumaṃ rāgādanibhṛtakareṣv ākṣipatsu priyeṣu
tvaṃ vyāpādaya māṃ no cen nihanmyātmānam ātmanā
asya dagdhodarasyārthe kaḥ kuryāt pātakaṃ mahat
kvacidvivādo viprāṇāmabhūdvedavinirṇaye
janaṃ prayānti tāpārtā maharlokanivāsinaḥ
upāyajño 'lpakāyo 'pi na śūraiḥ paribhūyate
mṛgo 'bravīt kamanena uttarottareṇa sarvair ekatra viśrambhālāpaiḥ sukham anubhavadbhiḥ sthīyatām
vinaśvare vihāyāsthāṃ yaśaḥ pālaya mitra me
sa āha śṛṇu kim anurakto virakto vā mayi svāmīti jñāsyāmi
sa cintayaty eva bhiyas tvad eṣyatīr aho durantā balavadvirodhitā
tato rahasi sasmāra sā taṃ nāgakumārakam

sāpi bhartṛdārikā tadvacanākarṇanābhijñātasvapurātanajananavṛttāntā nūnamayaṃ matprāṇavallabhaḥ iti manasi jānatī rāgapallavitamānasā samandahāsamavocat saumya purā śāmbo yajñavatīsaṃdeśaparipālanāya tathāvidhaṃ haṃsabandhanam akārṣīt
kiṣkindhāṃ rāmasahito jagāma ca guhāṃ tadā
sūryaḥ sa evābhyadhikaṃ cakāśe jajvāla saumyārcir anīrito 'gniḥ
strībhṛtyau dānamānābhyāṃ dākṣiṇyenetarān janān
upāyena jayo yādṛg ripos tādṛṅ na hetibhiḥ
asya ca tvatprasādasya kimupakṛtya pratyupakṛtavatī bhaveyam
daśānano 'harat sītāṃ bandhanaṃ syān mahodadheḥ
na bhūtadānaṃ na suvarṇadānaṃ na gopradānaṃ na tathānnadānam
pṛṣṭaś ca kuto bhavān āgataḥ sārthād bhraṣṭaḥ
vihāya vāñchām udite madātyayād araktakaṇṭhasya rute śikhaṇḍinaḥ
nāśakatsaṃmukhe sthātuṃ kaṣṭo hyavinayakramaḥ
anāhūto viśed yas tu apṛṣṭo bahu bhāṣate
kākaś ca tasyopari sthitvā cañcvā kim api vilikhatu
abhajata śibikāṃ śivāya devī tanayavatī praṇipatya devatābhyaḥ
athābhyagacchatāṃ viprau dvāvasmadgṛhamekadā
śāpānto me bhujagaśayanād utthite śārṅgapāṇau śeṣān māsān gamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
tato 'sau nakulo brāhmaṇam āyāntam avalokya raktaviliptamukhapadaḥ satvaram upagamya taccaraṇayor luloṭha
tvayi jīvati jīvāmi citragrīva ivānagha
sugrīvāya ca tat sarvaṃ śaṃsad rāmo mahābalaḥ
tato mayoktam bhrātaḥ śuka kim evaṃ bravīṣi māṃ prati yathā śrīmaddevapādās tathā bhavān api
sampadi yasya na harṣo vipadi viṣādo raṇe ca bhīrutvam
vyāḍis tato 'vadad rājañ śarīre kṣaṇanaśvare
tadavalokanakutūhalena mahīpālenānujñātaḥ saḥ saṃkalpitārthasiddhisaṃbhāvanasamphullavadanaḥ sakalamohajanakamañjanaṃ locanayornikṣipya parito vyalokayat
ityādikaitavair dyūtam astuvan kitavāḥ kvacit
tārāsu candrastapatāṃ ca sūryaḥ putrastathā te dvipadeṣu varyaḥ
asmatputraṃ cūḍāmaṇināmānaṃ sarvajñasya saṃmatyā rājānaṃ kariṣyasi
niḥsṛtya kubjāśca mahākulebhyo vyūhāśca kairātakavāmanānām
kathamivainamanuraktā mādṛśeṣvapi puruṣasiṃheṣu sāvamānā pāpeyamavantisundarī
cāturvarṇyaṃ ca loke 'smin sve sve dharme niyokṣyati
śucitvam tyāgitā śauryaṃ sāmānyaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
bahuvidhaviṣayāstato yatātmā svahṛdayatoṣakarīḥ kriyā vidhāya
tac chrutvā jaradgavena uktaṃ ko 'yam āyāti dīrghakarṇo gṛdhram avalokya sabhayam āha hā hato 'smi yato 'yaṃ māṃ vyāpādayiṣyati
padakramākrāntam anantam ādi sthitaṃ tvam evākṣara viśvamūrte
rājavāhano 'pi yatra hṛdayavallabhāvalokanasukhamalabhata tadudyānaṃ virahavinodāya puṣpodbhavasamanvito jagāma
guṇigaṇagaṇanārambhe na patati kaṭhinī sasambhramād yasya
dhanena kiṃ yo na dadāti nāśnute balena kiṃ yaś ca ripūn na yādhatte
tārāsu candrastapatāṃ ca sūryaḥ putrastathā te dvipadeṣu varyaḥ
snigdho 'kuśalān nivārayati yas tat karma yan nirmalaṃ sā strī yātuvidhāyinī sa matimān yaḥ sadbhir abhyarcyate
sārasvatāya tenāpi mama sārasvatena ca
tadanujñātena tena saṃyamī nṛpasamīpam anāyi
strīṇāmeva ca śaktāḥ stha saṃrāge kiṃ punarnṛṇām
sā karayugena bāṣpajalam unmṛjya nijaśokaśaṅkūtpāṭanakṣamamiva māmavalokya śokahetumavocad dvijātmaja rājahaṃsamantriṇaḥ sitavarmaṇaḥ kanīyānātmajaḥ satyavarmā tīrthayātrāmiṣeṇa deśam enam āgacchat
alabdhāntau tapobhirmāṃ toṣayāmāsatuśca tau

athārdharātre nidrānilīnanetre parijane vijane śokapārāvāram apāram uttartum aśaknuvatī senāniveśadeśaṃ niḥśabdaleśaṃ śanairatikramya yasmin rathasya saṃsaktatayā tadānayanapalāyanaśrāntā gantumakṣamāḥ kṣamāpatirathyāḥ pathyākulāḥ pūrvamatiṣṭhaṃstasya nikaṭavaṭataroḥ śākhāyāṃ mṛtirekhāyāmiva kvaciduttarīyārddhena bandhanaṃ mṛtisādhanaṃ viracya martukāmābhirāmā vāṅmādhurīvirasīkṛtakalakaṇṭhakaṇṭhā sāśrukaṇṭhā vyalapal lāvaṇyopamitapuṣpasāyaka bhūnāyaka bhavāneva bhāvinyapi janmani vallabho bhavatu iti
vikale'pi hi parjanye jīvyate na tu bhūpatau
suhṛdāṃ hitakāmānāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti na bhāṣitam
upahāraś ca vijñeyāś catvāraś caiva sandhayaḥ
apriyāṇy api kurvāṇo yaḥ priyaḥ priya eva saḥ
rajāṃsi ahārṣīt malinīkarāṇi
tacchrutvā so 'bravīnmantrī rakṣo me darśyatāmiti
spṛśanti na nṛśaṃsānāṃ hṛdayaṃ bandhubuddhayaḥ
vakṣyanti sarvaśāstreṣu prāyaśo ye 'pi vidviṣaḥ
sa tu tatra viśeṣadurlabhaḥ sad upanyasyati kṛtyavartma yaḥ
rājovāca bho bhoḥ paṇḍitāḥ śrūyatāṃ mama vacanam
asya tālataroḥ pṛṣṭhe tiṣṭha rātrāvalakṣitaḥ
varāṅganāgaṇakalilaṃ nṛpātmajastato balādvanamatinīyate sma tat
tataścāgatya māmeva vādāyāhvayate sma saḥ
ityāgatāvegamaniṣṭabuddhyā buddhvā narendraṃ sa munirbabhāṣe
agatāv aridṛṣṭigocaraṃ śitanistriṃśayujau maheṣudhī
diśaḥ prasthāpayāmāsa didṛkṣur janakātmajām
nāryaḥ kṛśebhyaśca niveśanebhyo devānuyānadhvajavatpraṇemuḥ
āstāṃ mānasatuṣṭaye sukṛtināṃ nītir navoḍheva vaḥ kalyāṇaṃ kurutāṃ janasya bhagavāṃś candrārdhacūḍāmaṇiḥ
aṇur apy upahanti vigrahaḥ prabhum antaḥprakṛtiprakopajaḥ

tadākārasaṃpadāśāśṛṅkhalitahṛdayo yaḥ saṃbandhayogyaḥ sāhasiko ratimandire taṃ yakṣaṃ nirjitya tayā ekasakhīsametayā mṛgākṣyā saṃlāpāmṛtasukhamanubhūya kuśalī nirgamiṣyati tena cakravākasaṃśayākārapayodharā vivāhanīyeti siddhenaikenāvādīti purajanasya purato bhavadīyaiḥ satyavākyairjanairasakṛt kathanīyam
dhanaṃ tāvad asulabhaṃ labdhaṃ kṛcchreṇa pālyate
athābravīd rājasutaḥ sa sūtaṃ naraiścaturbhir hriyate ka eṣaḥ
ṛṣer dharmātmanas tasya kāruṇyaṃ samapadyata
nimantrayāmāsa yathopacāraṃ purā vasiṣṭhaṃ sa ivāntidevaḥ
praṇamanti sadā suyodhanaṃ prathame mānabhṛtāṃ na vṛṣṇayaḥ
saṃdhimātraṃ na jānāsi māśabdodakaśabdayoḥ
saṃhatās tu haranty ete mama jālaṃ vihaṃgamāḥ
bhartuḥ kaṇṭhacchavir iti gaṇaiḥ sādaraṃ vīkṣyamāṇaḥ puṇyaṃ yāyās tribhuvanaguror dhāma caṇḍīśvarasya
kanyāsāreṇa niyukto mānapālo nāma vīraketumantrī mānadhanaś caturaṅgabalasamanvito 'nyatra racitaśibirastaṃ nijanāthāvamānakhinnamānaso 'ntarbibheda iti
